Add the cauliflower rice and peas and stir-fry for 5 minutes until tender.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil and eggs and toss.
Finish with spring onions and cashews.

title: Creamy cottage cheese tomato pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, saving a mug of water before draining.
Blend the cottage cheese, peppers, tomato paste, garlic, parmesan and salt until smooth.
Warm the oil in the empty pasta pan and wilt the spinach.
Pour in the sauce and warm gently without boiling.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water.
Serve with basil.

title: High-protein cottage cheese mac & cheese
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes, then drain.
Blend the cottage cheese, milk, mustard and garlic powder until smooth.
Pour into the empty pan over a low heat.
Stir in the cheddar until melted.
Add the pasta and broccoli and toss.
Dust with paprika and pepper.

title: Naan pizza night
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix the passata with the oregano.
Spread the sauce over the naan.
Top with mozzarella, ham, mushrooms and pepper.
Bake for 8–10 minutes until bubbling.
Scatter with arugula and a drizzle of oil.

title: Peanut dan dan-style noodles
steps: Cook the noodles with the bok choy for 4 minutes, then drain, saving some water.
Fry the pork in the oil for 6 minutes until crispy.
Add the garlic and hoisin and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, chili, vinegar and 4 tbsp noodle water.
Toss the noodles in the sauce.
Top with the crispy pork, bok choy, spring onion and peanuts.

title: Upgraded ramen bowl with jammy egg
steps: Boil the eggs for 6½ minutes, cool and peel.
Simmer 800 ml water with the bouillon, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Whisk in the miso and soy sauce.
Cook the noodles in the broth for 4 minutes, adding the spinach at the end.
Ladle into bowls.
Top with halved eggs, spring onion and chili.

title: Pho-style chicken noodle soup
steps: Char the onion and ginger in a dry pan for 5 minutes — this gives the broth its depth.
Add 1.5 litres boiling water, the bouillon, cinnamon and five-spice and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and simmer for 15 minutes, then lift out and shred.
Stir the fish sauce into the broth.
Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 8 minutes, then drain.
Serve the noodles and chicken in the hot broth with sprouts, cilantro and lime.

title: Thai chicken larb rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil in a wok and cook the chicken for 6 minutes until cooked.
Take off the heat and stir in the fish sauce, lime juice, chili and sugar.
Fold through the red onion and herbs.
Pile the rice into bowls with lettuce leaves and cucumber.
Spoon over the larb and scoop up with the lettuce.

title: Sheet-pan chicken satay with cucumber salad
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix 2 tbsp peanut butter, 2 tbsp soy sauce, the curry powder and honey and coat the chicken.
Roast on a lined tray for 18–20 minutes until charred.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the rest of the peanut butter and soy with the lime juice and 4 tbsp hot water for a satay sauce, and toss the cucumber with the vinegar.
Serve the chicken over rice with satay sauce, cucumber salad and peanuts.

title: Miso butter mushroom gnocchi
steps: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan and fry the gnocchi for 8 minutes until golden all over. Set aside.
Add the mushrooms to the pan and cook over a high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the butter and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the miso with 3 tbsp water until glossy.
Return the gnocchi with the spinach and toss until wilted.
Finish with parmesan, spring onion and pepper.

title: Chicken shawarma wrap
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices, oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Cook in a hot pan for 6 minutes until charred and cooked through.
Spread the tortillas with hummus.
Fill with lettuce, tomato, cucumber and chicken, then roll up and toast seam-side down for 1 minute.

title: Tuna melt quesadilla
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, sweetcorn, spring onion and hot sauce.
Spread over half of each tortilla and scatter with cheddar.
Fold over and cook in a dry pan for 3 minutes on each side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges.

title: High-protein egg salad sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Mash with the yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, spring onion and salt.
Pile onto the bread with lettuce and a pinch of paprika.
Close the sandwiches and cut in half.

title: Cobb-style chopped salad
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool, peel and chop.
Cook the chicken and bacon in a frying pan until cooked and crisp, then chop.
Whisk the vinegar, oil and mustard.
Arrange the lettuce, tomato, egg, chicken, bacon and cheddar in rows and drizzle with dressing.

title: Turkey taco salad bowl
steps: Brown the turkey with the spices for 7 minutes, adding the beans and corn for the last 2.
Toast the tortilla strips in a dry pan until crisp.
Pile the lettuce and tomato into bowls.
Top with the turkey, salsa, yogurt and crispy tortilla strips.

title: Crunchy Asian-style chicken salad
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 3, then shred.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey and 1 tbsp warm water.
Toss the cabbage, carrot, edamame and spring onion with the dressing.
Top with the chicken.

title: Thai mango & shrimp noodle salad
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 5 minutes, then rinse cold.
Cook the shrimp in boiling water for 3 minutes until pink, then drain.
Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chili.
Toss everything with the dressing and top with peanuts.

title: Chickpea tabbouleh
steps: Cover the bulgur with 300 ml boiling water and leave for 15 minutes, then fluff.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil and salt.
Toss the bulgur with the chickpeas, herbs, tomato, cucumber and spring onion.
Pour over the dressing and toss again.

title: Cottage cheese tuna crunch wrap
steps: Mix the tuna, cottage cheese, celery, onion, mustard, lemon juice and pepper.
Lay lettuce and cucumber on each tortilla.
Spoon over the tuna mixture.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

title: Rainbow hummus wrap
steps: Spread the hummus over the tortillas.
Lay the vegetables and chickpeas in stripes down the middle.
Squeeze over a little lemon.
Roll up tightly and cut on the diagonal to show the colours.

title: Pesto chicken & mozzarella sandwich
steps: Cook the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes on each side until cooked through, then slice.
Split the baguette pieces and spread with pesto.
Fill with chicken, mozzarella, tomato and spinach.
Press the sandwiches in the hot pan for 1 minute on each side.

title: Broccoli cheddar soup
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the potato, broccoli, 900 ml boiling water and the bouillon and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the milk and most of the cheddar.
Serve with toast and the rest of the cheese on top.

title: Tomato basil soup with grilled cheese
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend with the basil and cream and season.
Make cheese sandwiches, butter the outsides and fry for 3 minutes on each side.
Cut into soldiers and dunk.

title: Lemon chicken orzo soup
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, oregano, chicken and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Lift out and shred the chicken, add the orzo and simmer for 9 minutes.
Return the chicken with the spinach and lemon juice, and season.

title: Miso tofu noodle soup
steps: Simmer 800 ml water with the bouillon, ginger and mushrooms for 5 minutes.
Add the noodles and bok choy and cook for 4 minutes.
Take off the heat and whisk in the miso, then add the tofu.
Serve topped with spring onions.

title: Thai coconut sweet potato soup
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, stock and most of the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth and add the lime juice.
Swirl in the rest of the coconut milk and serve with cilantro and warm naan.

title: Tuscan white bean & kale soup
steps: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and herbs, then the tomatoes, beans and stock.
Simmer for 12 minutes, then add the kale for 3 minutes.
Serve topped with parmesan and with the baguette.

title: Smoky black bean soup
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the beans, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend half the soup and stir it back in, then add the lime juice.
Toast the tortilla strips in a dry pan.
Serve with sour cream, avocado and the crispy strips.

title: Deconstructed sushi salad bowl
steps: Microwave the rice and edamame, covered, for 3 minutes, then stir in the vinegar.
Split between bowls.
Top with cucumber, avocado and carrot.
Finish with nori strips, soy sauce, sriracha and sesame seeds.

title: Crunchy Thai quinoa salad
steps: Simmer the quinoa in 500 ml water for 15 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 3, then drain and cool.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and 2 tbsp warm water.
Toss the quinoa and edamame with the cabbage, carrot and pepper.
Pour over the dressing and top with peanuts.

title: Bulgur salad with apple & feta
steps: Cover the bulgur with 400 ml boiling water for 15 minutes, then fluff and cool.
Whisk the oil, balsamic, honey and salt.
Toss the bulgur with the apple, onion and arugula.
Top with feta and walnuts and drizzle over the dressing.

title: Italian pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, then rinse cold and drain.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano.
Toss the pasta with everything else.
Chill for 30 minutes before eating, or pack for the week.

title: Lemony chicken orzo salad
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 minutes, then shred.
Cook the orzo for 9 minutes in salted boiling water, then rinse cold.
Whisk the lemon zest and juice, oil, oregano and salt.
Toss everything together with the dressing.

title: Warm crispy smashed potato salad
steps: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes with the eggs for the last 9, then drain and cool the eggs.
Smash the potatoes flat and fry with the bacon in the oil for 8 minutes until crisp.
Mix the yogurt, mustard, spring onion and salt.
Toss the potatoes with the dressing, crumble over the bacon and top with the eggs, quartered.

title: Greek cucumber salad with pita
steps: Mix the yogurt with the garlic, lemon juice and salt.
Toss the cucumber, chickpeas, tomatoes and mint with the oil.
Spread the yogurt on plates and pile the salad on top.
Serve with warm pita.

title: Microwave tuna sweet potato jacket
steps: Prick the sweet potatoes and microwave for 8–10 minutes until soft, turning halfway.
Mix the tuna, yogurt, sweetcorn, spring onion and salt.
Split the potatoes open.
Fill with the tuna mixture and serve with arugula.

title: Air-fryer pizza toast
steps: Spread the passata over the bread and sprinkle with oregano.
Top with mozzarella and ham.
Air-fry at 190°C (375°F) for 5–6 minutes until bubbling.
Cut into soldiers and eat hot.

title: Kimchi grilled cheese
steps: Fill the bread with the cheeses, kimchi and spring onion.
Butter the outsides.
Fry over a medium heat for 3 minutes on each side, pressing down, until golden and melted.
Cut in half and serve hot.

title: Chicken tikka wrap
steps: Mix half the yogurt with the spices and coat the chicken.
Cook in the oil in a hot pan for 8 minutes until charred and cooked.
Mix the rest of the yogurt with the mint and lemon juice.
Fill the tortillas with lettuce, cucumber, onion, chicken and mint yogurt, then roll up.

title: Avocado & chickpea 'ceviche' tostadas
steps: Toss the chickpeas with the lime juice, onion and salt and leave for 5 minutes, crushing a few.
Fold in the tomato, cucumber, avocado and cilantro.
Toast the tortillas in a dry pan until crisp.
Pile the salad onto the crisp tortillas.

title: Cottage cheese protein pancakes
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, oats and baking powder until smooth.
Heat a little butter in a non-stick pan over a medium heat.
Cook small pancakes for 2 minutes until bubbles form, then flip for 1 minute.
Stack with berries and maple syrup.

title: Egg & bean breakfast quesadilla
steps: Scramble the eggs with the salt until just set.
Fill half of each tortilla with egg, beans, spinach and cheese.
Fold and toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes on each side.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

title: Green shakshuka with feta
steps: Cook the spring onions, garlic and cumin in the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook until hot and most of the water has gone.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites set.
Scatter with feta and serve with toast.

title: Turkish-style eggs with chili butter
steps: Mix the yogurt with the garlic and salt and spread on two plates.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes.
Melt the butter with the paprika and chili until foaming.
Sit the eggs on the yogurt, spoon over the chili butter and serve with toast.

title: Smoky homemade beans on toast
steps: Simmer the beans with the passata, paprika, maple syrup, Worcestershire and salt for 8 minutes.
Toast the sourdough.
Spoon the beans over the toast.
Top with grated cheddar.

title: Apple pie overnight oats
steps: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt, apple, cinnamon and maple syrup.
Split between two jars.
Cover and chill overnight.
Top with walnuts and an extra pinch of cinnamon.

title: Carrot cake overnight oats
steps: Mix the oats, milk, carrot, raisins, cinnamon and maple syrup.
Split between two jars and chill overnight.
Loosen the cream cheese with a splash of milk.
Top the oats with the cream cheese 'frosting'.

title: Banana bread baked oats
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Blend the oats, 1½ bananas, egg, milk, baking powder and cinnamon.
Pour into two small dishes, top with the rest of the banana, walnuts and chocolate.
Bake for 25 minutes until risen and golden.

title: Peanut butter & berry chia jam toast
steps: Simmer the berries for 5 minutes, mashing as they soften.
Stir in the chia and maple syrup and leave to thicken for 5 minutes.
Toast the bread and spread with peanut butter.
Top with chia jam and banana.

title: Mango lassi smoothie
steps: Put everything in the blender.
Blend until completely smooth.
Add a splash more milk if it's too thick.
Pour into glasses and dust with a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Green glow smoothie
steps: Blend the spinach with the milk first until no leaves are left.
Add the banana, mango and yogurt.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into two glasses.

title: Chocolate peanut butter smoothie
steps: Put the banana, milk, yogurt, peanut butter and oats in the blender.
Add most of the chocolate.
Blend until thick and smooth.
Pour and top with the rest of the chocolate.

title: Stovetop granola yogurt pots
steps: Melt the butter in a frying pan and add the oats, walnuts and cinnamon.
Toast for 4 minutes, then stir in the maple syrup and cook until clustered.
Spread out to cool and crisp up.
Layer the yogurt, berries and granola in glasses.

title: Breakfast burrito bowl
steps: Fry the potato in the oil with the paprika and salt for 12 minutes until crisp.
Warm the beans in a small pan.
Scramble the eggs until just set.
Build bowls with potatoes, eggs, beans, salsa and cheddar.

title: Savory oats with a jammy egg
steps: Boil the eggs for 6½ minutes, then cool and peel.
Simmer the oats in 400 ml water with the bouillon for 5 minutes, stirring, then stir in the spinach.
Stir in the parmesan and soy sauce.
Top with halved eggs, spring onion and chili.

title: Breakfast fried rice
steps: Fry the bacon in a wok until crisp.
Add the rice and peas and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Push to one side, scramble 1 egg into the rice and toss with the soy sauce.
Fry the other eggs and serve on top with spring onion.

title: Air-fryer sweet potato toast
steps: Brush the sweet potato slices with oil.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway, until tender.
Spread with peanut butter and top with banana and cinnamon.
Serve with yogurt and a drizzle of honey.

title: Grab-and-go baked oat cups
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Mix the oats, banana, eggs, milk, baking powder, cinnamon and maple syrup.
Fold in the berries and divide between the cases.
Bake for 20 minutes until set and golden. Keep in the fridge for 4 days.

title: Cinnamon apple porridge
steps: Cook the apple in the butter with half the cinnamon for 3 minutes until soft.
Simmer the oats in the milk with the rest of the cinnamon for 5 minutes, stirring.
Spoon into bowls.
Top with the cinnamon apples, walnuts and maple syrup.

title: Tofu scramble breakfast tacos
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil with the turmeric, cumin and salt for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with tofu scramble and salsa.

title: Ham & egg breakfast cups
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Line 4 muffin holes with the ham to make cups.
Crack in an egg and top with cheddar and pepper.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until set and serve with toast.

title: Veggie frittata squares
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and oil a square baking tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt.
Scatter the vegetables and feta in the tin and pour over the eggs.
Bake for 25 minutes until set, then cut into squares. They keep for 4 days.

title: Mango lime yogurt crunch bowl
steps: Toast the oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden, then stir in half the honey.
Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Top with the mango and a squeeze of lime.
Scatter over the crunchy oats and drizzle with the rest of the honey.

title: Apple bircher muesli
steps: Mix the oats, grated apple, milk, yogurt and raisins.
Cover and chill overnight.
Stir and loosen with a splash of milk.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Banana split yogurt bowl
steps: Lay the banana halves in two bowls.
Spoon the yogurt down the middle.
Top with berries and a drizzle of peanut butter.
Finish with grated chocolate and peanuts.

title: Cottage cheese ranch dip
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, garlic and onion powders, parsley and lemon juice until smooth.
Chill for 10 minutes.
Serve with the veg sticks.

title: Whipped feta dip with cucumber
steps: Blend the feta, yogurt, lemon juice and half the oil until whipped and smooth.
Spread in a bowl and swirl with the rest of the oil, the honey and chili.
Serve with cucumber and pita.

title: Edamame hummus
steps: Boil the edamame for 4 minutes, then drain and cool.
Blend with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, oil, salt and 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Serve with carrot sticks and rice cakes.

title: Air-fryer parmesan zucchini chips
steps: Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan and paprika.
Dip the zucchini in egg, then the crumbs.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp.

title: Crispy kale chips
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (300°F).
Massage the kale with the oil, garlic powder and salt and spread out on two trays.
Bake for 12 minutes until crisp, then sprinkle with parmesan.

title: Frozen chocolate peanut butter banana bites
steps: Sandwich pairs of banana slices with a little peanut butter.
Dip halfway in melted chocolate and lay on a lined tray.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and freeze for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate-dipped banana pops
steps: Push a lolly stick into each banana half.
Dip in the melted chocolate and roll in the peanuts.
Freeze on a lined tray for 2 hours.

title: Peanut butter chocolate protein balls
steps: Mix everything together in a bowl.
Roll into 12 balls.
Chill for 30 minutes. They keep for a week in the fridge.

title: Sweet & salty trail mix
steps: Pop the corn in a lidded pan or the microwave in a covered bowl.
Mix with the nuts, raisins and chocolate.
Split into 4 small tubs.

title: Cinnamon sugar popcorn
steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded pan with 3 kernels until they pop.
Add the rest of the kernels, cover and shake until the popping slows.
Toss with the melted butter, cinnamon and sugar.

title: Apple nachos
steps: Toss the apple slices in lemon juice and spread on a plate.
Drizzle with the warm peanut butter and chocolate.
Scatter with oats and raisins.

title: Cucumber cream cheese bites
steps: Spread or pipe the cream cheese onto the cucumber slices.
Mix the sesame, garlic powder and chili.
Sprinkle over and serve cold.

title: Caprese skewers
steps: Thread the tomatoes, mozzarella and basil onto small skewers.
Drizzle with the oil and balsamic.
Sprinkle with salt and serve.

title: Mini pita pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Spread the pita halves with passata and sprinkle with oregano.
Top with mozzarella and olives and bake for 8 minutes.

title: Rice cakes with peanut butter & banana
steps: Spread the rice cakes with peanut butter.
Top with banana slices.
Finish with cinnamon and a drizzle of honey.

title: Berry cottage cheese ice cream
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, berries and honey until completely smooth.
Tip into a freezer tub.
Freeze for 3 hours, stirring once, and soften for 10 minutes before scooping.

title: Two-ingredient mango nice cream
steps: Freeze the mango and banana pieces overnight.
Blend with the lime juice, scraping down often, until smooth like soft-serve.
Eat straight away or freeze for 30 minutes to firm up.

title: Chocolate chia pudding cups
steps: Whisk the chia, milk, melted chocolate and maple syrup.
Whisk again after 5 minutes, then divide between 4 small cups.
Chill for 4 hours and top with berries.

title: Honey chili roasted cashews
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Toss the cashews with the honey, chili and salt and spread on a lined tray.
Roast for 10 minutes, stirring once, then cool to crisp up.

title: Air-fryer tortilla chips & salsa
steps: Toss the tortilla triangles with the oil, paprika and salt.
Air-fry at 180°C (350°F) for 5–6 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Squeeze over the lime and serve with salsa.

title: Soy-marinated jammy eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 6½ minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic, spring onion, chili, sesame and 4 tbsp water.
Marinate the eggs in a jar in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
Halve and spoon over some of the marinade.

title: Chunky guacamole with veg sticks
steps: Mash the avocado roughly with the lime juice and salt.
Fold in the onion and cilantro.
Serve with the veg sticks.

title: Peanut butter yogurt dip with apple
steps: Whisk the yogurt, peanut butter, honey and cinnamon until smooth.
Serve with the apple slices for dipping.

title: Puffed rice paper chips
steps: Brush the rice paper quarters very lightly with oil.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 1–2 minutes per batch until puffed.
Sprinkle with sesame, chili and salt and serve with sweet chili sauce.

title: Two-ingredient banana oat cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Mix the banana, oats, chocolate and cinnamon and drop 12 spoonfuls onto a lined tray.
Bake for 15 minutes until golden, then cool on the tray.

title: Crispy rice paper dumplings
steps: Mix the pork, cabbage, spring onion, garlic, ginger, 1 tbsp soy sauce and the sesame oil.
Dip 2 rice paper sheets together in warm water for 5 seconds and lay them flat.
Put a spoonful of filling in the middle and fold into a tight square parcel. Repeat to make 8.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over a medium heat and fry the dumplings for 5 minutes on each side until crisp and cooked through.
Mix the rest of the soy sauce with the vinegar and chili flakes for dipping.
Heat the rice and serve with the dumplings and dipping sauce.

title: Greek-style sheet-pan nachos
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Toss the pita triangles with 1 tbsp oil and bake on a large tray for 8 minutes until crisp.
Toss the chicken with the oregano, juice of half the lemon and salt, then fry in the rest of the oil for 8 minutes.
Grate half the cucumber into the yogurt with the garlic and the rest of the lemon juice. Dice the other half.
Pile the chicken over the pita chips, scatter with feta and bake for 4 minutes.
Top with tomatoes, diced cucumber, onion and olives, and drizzle with the tzatziki.

title: Slow-cooker shredded beef tacos
steps: Rub the beef with the spices and salt.
Put the onion and garlic in the slow cooker with the beef, tomatoes, bouillon and 150 ml water.
Cook on low for 7 hours until the beef falls apart — chuck is the cut that does this.
Shred the beef in the sauce and squeeze in the juice of 1 lime.
Dip each tortilla in the cooking juices and fry in a hot pan for 1 minute on each side.
Fill with beef and top with red onion, cilantro and lime, with a cup of the juices for dipping.

title: Hot honey halloumi tacos
steps: Toss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime.
Mash the avocado with the juice of the other lime and a pinch of salt.
Fry the halloumi in a dry pan for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Warm the honey with the hot sauce and chili flakes and toss with the halloumi.
Char the sweetcorn in the same pan for 3 minutes, and warm the tortillas.
Spread the tortillas with avocado and fill with halloumi, corn, slaw, yogurt and cilantro.

title: Sheet-pan chicken quesadilla
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Fry the chicken with the oil, spices and salt for 8 minutes, then stir in the beans and pepper.
Lay 5 tortillas over a lined tray so they overlap the edges and cover the base.
Spread over the chicken mixture and two-thirds of the cheese, then put the last tortilla in the middle.
Fold the edges in, scatter the rest of the cheese on top, put another tray on top and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the top tray and bake for 5 minutes more until crisp, then cut into squares and serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: French onion pasta
steps: Melt the butter in a large pan and cook the onions with the thyme and salt over a medium-low heat for 25 minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic and Worcestershire and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and bring to the boil.
Add the pasta and simmer for 11 minutes, stirring often, until it's tender and the liquid is saucy.
Stir in the parmesan.
Top with the mozzarella, cover for 2 minutes to melt and serve.

title: Baked garlic & herb cream cheese pasta
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Put the tomatoes and garlic in a baking dish with the oil and chili, and sit the cream cheese in the middle.
Sprinkle the herbs over the cream cheese and bake for 25 minutes until the tomatoes burst.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti, saving a mug of water before draining.
Mash everything in the dish into a creamy sauce and stir in the spinach.
Toss in the spaghetti with a splash of pasta water and finish with basil and pepper.

title: Mongolian-style beef with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, adding the broccoli for the last 4, then drain.
Toss the beef in the cornstarch.
Fry the beef in the oil in batches over a high heat for 2 minutes until crisp, then set aside.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan for 30 seconds.
Stir in the soy sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water and bubble for 2 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the beef and spring onions in the sauce and serve over the rice and broccoli.

title: General Tso-style crispy tofu
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, adding the broccoli for the last 4, then drain.
Toss the tofu in 2 tbsp cornstarch.
Fry in the oil for 10 minutes, turning, until crisp all over, then set aside.
Whisk the hoisin, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, chili flakes, the rest of the cornstarch and 100 ml water.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and bubble until thick.
Toss in the tofu and serve over rice and broccoli with sesame seeds.

title: Kung pao chicken
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over a high heat for 6 minutes until cooked.
Add the chili, garlic, ginger and peppers and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rest of the soy sauce, the vinegar and honey.
Toss through the peanuts and spring onions and serve over rice.

title: Chicken chow mein
steps: Cook the noodles for 4 minutes, then drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cabbage and carrot and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and hoisin and toss for 2 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts and toss for 30 seconds so they stay crunchy.
Serve topped with spring onions.

title: Pad Thai-style shrimp noodles
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6 minutes, then drain.
Mix the fish sauce, sugar, ketchup and the juice of half the lime.
Stir-fry the shrimp and garlic in the oil for 2 minutes, then push to one side and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes until coated.
Toss in the bean sprouts and spring onions.
Serve with peanuts, chili flakes and lime wedges.

title: Slow-cooker massaman-style beef curry
steps: Whisk the curry paste, cinnamon, peanut butter and coconut milk in the slow cooker.
Add the beef, potatoes and onion and stir to coat.
Cook on low for 6 hours until the beef is tender.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Season the curry with the fish sauce and lime juice.
Serve over the rice, scattered with peanuts.

title: Goan-style coconut fish curry
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 8 minutes.
Lower in the fish and simmer gently for 5 minutes until it flakes.
Squeeze in the lime and serve over rice.

title: Mild chicken korma
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute, then the chicken for 5 minutes.
Blend the cashews with the coconut milk until smooth and pour it in.
Simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Stir in the yogurt off the heat and serve with the rice and cilantro.

title: Lamb keema with peas
steps: Brown the lamb in a dry pan for 6 minutes, then pour off most of the fat.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the peas for 3 minutes.
Serve with warm naan, yogurt and cilantro.

title: Aloo gobi with naan
steps: Fry the cumin in the oil for 30 seconds, then add the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, turmeric and garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and cauliflower and toss to coat.
Pour in the tomatoes, salt and 100 ml water, cover and cook for 18 minutes until tender.
Stir in the peas for 2 minutes.
Serve with warm naan and cilantro.

title: One-pot chicken biryani-style rice
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, spices and salt.
Fry the onions in the oil for 10 minutes until golden, and keep a handful aside.
Add the garlic, ginger and chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice, then the stock and raisins, and bring to the boil.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes, then leave to steam for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and top with the crispy onions, cashews and cilantro.

title: Japanese-style chicken curry
steps: Cook the chicken, onion, carrot and potato in the oil in a deep pan for 6 minutes.
Add 700 ml boiling water and the bouillon and simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
In a small pan, melt the butter, stir in the flour and curry powder and cook for 2 minutes into a paste.
Whisk the paste into the curry with the honey and soy sauce and simmer for 5 minutes until thick and glossy.
Serve the curry over the rice.

title: Air-fryer chicken katsu bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Dust the chicken in half the flour, dip in egg, then press into the breadcrumbs.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 14 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Melt the butter, stir in the rest of the flour and the curry powder, then whisk in 300 ml water, the bouillon, honey and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Toss the cabbage with a pinch of salt.
Slice the katsu and serve over rice with the curry sauce and cabbage.

title: Okonomiyaki-style cabbage pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs and stock into a batter.
Fold in the cabbage and most of the spring onion.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and pour in half the batter, shaping a thick round pancake.
Lay 2 slices of bacon on top and cook for 5 minutes, then flip and cook for 5 minutes until the bacon is crisp. Repeat.
Mix the hoisin with the Worcestershire.
Brush over the pancakes, zigzag with mayonnaise and finish with nori, sesame and spring onion.

title: Oyakodon chicken & egg rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Simmer the stock, soy sauce and honey in a small frying pan.
Add the onion and chicken and simmer for 7 minutes until cooked through.
Pour the egg over in a slow circle, cover and cook for 1 minute until just set but still soft.
Slide over the bowls of rice.
Top with spring onion and nori.

title: Beef bibimbap bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Brown the beef with the garlic and 2 tbsp soy sauce for 7 minutes.
Quickly fry the carrot, then the spinach, in a little sesame oil, seasoning with the rest of the soy sauce.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the sesame oil until the whites are crisp.
Arrange the beef and vegetables over the rice and top with an egg.
Loosen the gochujang with 1 tbsp water, drizzle over and scatter with sesame. Mix it all up to eat.

title: Air-fryer Korean-style fried cauliflower
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the flour, cornstarch and milk into a batter and toss the cauliflower in it.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 18 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy sauce and garlic in a pan for 1 minute.
Toss the cauliflower in the sticky sauce.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds and spring onions.

title: Bulgogi-style pork lettuce wraps
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic and gochujang.
Brown the pork in the oil for 7 minutes until crispy.
Pour in the sauce and cook for 2 minutes until sticky.
Put out the lettuce cups, cucumber and kimchi.
Fill each lettuce leaf with rice, pork and toppings and scatter with sesame.

title: Spanish garlic shrimp & white beans
steps: Warm the oil in a wide pan over a low heat with the garlic and chili for 3 minutes until the garlic is pale golden.
Add the beans and paprika and simmer for 4 minutes, crushing a few so they soak up the garlic oil.
Turn up the heat, push the beans aside and add the shrimp with the salt.
Cook for 2 minutes on each side until pink.
Squeeze over the lemon and scatter with parsley.
Serve from the pan with torn bread for mopping up.

title: Portuguese-style piri-piri chicken & rice
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix the paprika, chili, garlic, lemon juice, vinegar, oil, oregano and salt and rub all over the chicken.
Roast on a tray for 30–35 minutes until charred and cooked through, basting once.
Cook the rice with the turmeric in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3, then drain.
Spoon the tray juices over the rice.
Serve the chicken with the rice and a lettuce and tomato salad.

title: Greek green bean & potato stew with feta
steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a deep lidded pan for 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the potatoes, beans, tomatoes, oregano, salt and 200 ml water.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until everything is soft and the sauce is rich.
Taste and add more salt and a drizzle of oil.
Crumble over the feta.
Serve with bread to mop up the sauce.

title: Shrimp saganaki-style orzo
steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a deep pan for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili and oregano for 1 minute.
Stir in the orzo, tomatoes, 600 ml boiling water and the bouillon and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often.
Nestle in the shrimp and crumble over the feta.
Cover and cook for 4 minutes until the shrimp are pink and the feta is soft.
Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Moussaka-style lamb & eggplant skillet
steps: Fry the eggplant in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 8 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Brown the lamb and onion in the same pan for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, cinnamon and oregano.
Stir in the tomatoes, salt and eggplant and simmer for 8 minutes.
Whisk the yogurt, egg and half the parmesan and spread over the top.
Scatter with the rest of the parmesan.
Grill or bake at 220°C (425°F) for 6 minutes until golden and set.

title: Turkey stuffed zucchini boats
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Scoop the middle out of the zucchini halves and chop it.
Brown the turkey, onion and chopped zucchini for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and herbs.
Stir in the passata and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fill the zucchini boats, top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake for 20 minutes.
Scatter with basil and serve with warm baguette.

title: Easy eggplant parmesan bake
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Brush the eggplant slices with 2 tbsp oil and roast for 15 minutes — thin slices cook fast.
Simmer the passata with the garlic, herbs, salt and the rest of the oil for 10 minutes.
Layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and parmesan in a baking dish, finishing with cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes until bubbling.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti and toss with a little of the sauce.
Scatter with basil and serve.

title: Sausage, kale & chili penne
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, saving a mug of water before draining.
Fry the sausage meat in the oil, breaking it up, for 8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Add the garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Add the kale with a splash of pasta water and cook for 3 minutes until wilted.
Toss in the pasta, parmesan, lemon juice and more pasta water until glossy.
Serve with extra parmesan.

title: Aglio e olio with broccoli & white beans
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes. Save a mug of water and drain.
Toast the breadcrumbs in 1 tbsp oil until golden, then set aside.
Warm the rest of the oil with the garlic and chili over a low heat for 3 minutes until the garlic is pale gold.
Add the beans and warm through.
Toss in the spaghetti, broccoli, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parsley and the crispy breadcrumbs.

title: One-pan skillet lasagne
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large lidded pan for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and herbs.
Stir in the passata, salt and 300 ml water and bring to a simmer.
Push the broken lasagne sheets into the sauce and add the spinach.
Cover and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring once, until the pasta is tender.
Dollop over the cottage cheese, scatter with mozzarella and parmesan, cover for 3 minutes to melt.
Serve straight from the pan.

title: One-pan Mexican quinoa
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Stir in the quinoa, tomatoes, 400 ml boiling water and the bouillon.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the quinoa is cooked.
Stir in the beans and sweetcorn and warm through.
Finish with lime juice and cilantro.

title: Chicken tinga tostadas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Poach the chicken in simmering water for 14 minutes, then shred.
Brush the tortillas with a little oil and bake on trays for 8 minutes until crisp.
Cook the onion in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the passata, salt and shredded chicken and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm and mash the beans with a splash of water.
Spread the tostadas with beans, pile on the chicken and top with lettuce, sour cream and feta.

title: Chicken & shrimp jambalaya
steps: Brown the chicken and chorizo in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the onion, celery and pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, paprika, thyme and rice.
Add the tomatoes, 600 ml boiling water and the bouillon, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the shrimp, cover and cook for 4 minutes until pink and the rice is tender.
Leave to stand for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Philly cheesesteak-style sandwiches
steps: Cook the onions and pepper in half the oil for 10 minutes until soft and golden, then set aside.
Sear the steak in the rest of the oil over a very high heat for 2 minutes with the salt, pepper and Worcestershire.
Return the onions and peppers and toss together.
Split into 4 piles in the pan and lay the mozzarella on top.
Cover for 1 minute to melt.
Split and toast the baguettes and scoop in the cheesy steak.

title: Turkey sloppy joes
steps: Brown the turkey, onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Stir in the passata, Worcestershire, honey and salt.
Simmer for 10 minutes until thick and saucy.
Toast the buns.
Pile in the turkey and eat with plenty of napkins.

title: BBQ chicken stuffed sweet potatoes
steps: Prick the sweet potatoes and microwave for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway, until soft.
Meanwhile, poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 minutes, then shred and toss with the BBQ sauce.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice.
Split the potatoes and fill with BBQ chicken, sweetcorn and cheddar.
Microwave for 1 minute to melt the cheese.
Top with the slaw, yogurt and spring onions.

title: Cottage pie with sweet potato mash
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes for 12 minutes until soft, then mash with the butter and a pinch of salt.
At the same time, brown the beef with the onion and carrot for 10 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire, thyme, bouillon and 300 ml water and simmer for 8 minutes, then add the peas.
Tip into a baking dish and spread over the mash.
Scatter with cheddar.
Grill or bake at 220°C (425°F) for 10 minutes until golden at the edges.

title: Creamy chicken & leek pie with mash
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with half the butter and a splash of the milk.
Meanwhile, brown the chicken in the rest of the butter for 5 minutes, then add the leeks for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then gradually the rest of the milk, and simmer for 3 minutes until thick. Add the mustard, peas and salt.
Tip into a baking dish and spread over the mash.
Scatter with cheddar.
Grill or bake at 220°C (425°F) for 10 minutes until golden.

title: Toad in the hole with onion gravy
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Roast the sausages in the oil in a roasting tin for 10 minutes.
Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and salt into a smooth batter.
Pour the batter around the sausages in the hot tin and bake for 25 minutes without opening the door, until puffed and golden.
Meanwhile, cook the onions in the butter for 12 minutes until golden.
Add the stock and the cornstarch mixed with a splash of water and simmer until thick.
Steam the green beans and serve with the toad in the hole and gravy.

title: Creamy chicken, leek & mustard one-pot
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a deep pan for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Soften the leeks and garlic in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, stock and chicken, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the mustard, cream and peas and simmer for 3 minutes.
Season with salt.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

title: Crispy chili beef rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the beef in the cornstarch until coated.
Fry in the oil over a high heat in batches for 3 minutes until very crisp, then drain on paper.
Pour off most of the oil and stir-fry the pepper, onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the sweet chili sauce, soy sauce and vinegar and bubble for 1 minute.
Toss the beef back in and serve over rice with spring onions.

title: Cowboy caviar with tortilla chips
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and bake the tortilla triangles for 8 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, chili powder and salt.
Toss the beans, sweetcorn, pepper, tomatoes, onion and cilantro in the dressing.
Scoop up with the chips. It keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

title: Crispy rice salad
steps: Mix the rice with the curry paste and press into a thin layer in a non-stick pan with the oil.
Fry over a medium-high heat for 8 minutes without stirring until crisp underneath, then break into chunks.
Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce and sugar.
Toss the crispy rice with the cucumber, onion, cilantro and peanuts in the dressing.

title: Chicken, grape & walnut salad cups
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 minutes, then cool and dice.
Mix the yogurt, mustard and lemon juice with a pinch of salt.
Fold in the chicken, grapes, celery and walnuts.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

title: Tuna niçoise salad
steps: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes, adding the eggs for the last 8 and the beans for the last 3, then cool in cold water.
Peel and halve the eggs and slice the potatoes.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomato, tuna and eggs and drizzle with the dressing.

title: Panzanella bread salad
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss the bread with 1 tbsp oil and bake for 10 minutes until crisp.
Toss the tomatoes with the salt and leave for 5 minutes to release their juices — that's the dressing.
Add the cucumber, onion, the rest of the oil and the vinegar.
Toss in the bread and basil, leave for 5 minutes to soak, then top with the mozzarella.

title: Fattoush salad with crispy chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss the pita and chickpeas with 1 tbsp oil and the paprika and bake for 15 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the lemon juice, the rest of the oil and the salt.
Toss the lettuce, cucumber, tomato, spring onion and parsley in the dressing.
Top with the crispy pita and chickpeas.

title: Make-ahead chicken noodle soup jars
steps: Split the bouillon, miso, soy sauce and ginger between two large jars.
Layer in the dry noodles, chicken, carrot, spinach and spring onion.
Seal and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
At lunch, fill the jar with boiling water, close the lid for 5 minutes, then stir.

title: Spinach & feta quesadilla
steps: Wilt the spinach in a dry pan, then squeeze out the water.
Scatter the spinach, feta, mozzarella, peppers and oregano over half of each tortilla.
Fold and cook in the dry pan for 3 minutes on each side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with yogurt.

title: BLT pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Fry the bacon until crisp, then chop.
Mix the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic powder and pepper.
Toss the pasta with the tomatoes and dressing, then fold in the lettuce and bacon just before eating.

title: Soy butter egg rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pan and fry the eggs until crispy at the edges with runny yolks.
Spoon the rice into bowls and drizzle with the soy sauce.
Top with the eggs, avocado, spring onion, nori and sesame.

title: Gazpacho with garlic croutons
steps: Blend the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, garlic, beans, vinegar, 3 tbsp oil and salt until very smooth.
Chill for at least 30 minutes.
Fry the bread cubes in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes until golden.
Serve the cold soup topped with croutons and a drizzle of oil.

title: Quick minestrone
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and herbs, then the tomatoes, 1.2 litres boiling water, the bouillon and the beans, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and zucchini and simmer for 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Serve with parmesan.

title: Sweetcorn & potato chowder
steps: Fry the bacon in the butter until crisp, then lift out half for the top.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then the potatoes, corn, paprika and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend a third of the soup and stir it back in with the milk.
Serve topped with the crispy bacon and spring onions, with toast.

title: Pea & ham soup
steps: Cook the onion in the butter for 5 minutes.
Add the potato and stock and simmer for 10 minutes, then add the peas for 3 minutes.
Blend with the mint until smooth.
Serve topped with the shredded ham and a swirl of yogurt, with toast.

title: Chicken mulligatawny soup
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and apple in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute, then the lentils, 1.2 litres boiling water, the bouillon and the whole chicken breasts, and simmer for 18 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and shred it, then blend the soup with the coconut milk.
Return the chicken and add the lemon juice.

title: Roast veg & hummus pittas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Toss the vegetables with the oil and cumin and roast for 20 minutes.
Warm the pittas in the oven for the last 3 minutes.
Spread the pittas with hummus and pile on the roast vegetables.
Top with feta and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Pizza pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, tomato paste and oregano into a pizza-flavoured dressing.
Toss the pasta with the ham, mozzarella, tomatoes, pepper and olives.
Pour over the dressing and finish with basil.

title: Korean-style tuna mayo rice bowl
steps: Heat the rice following the pack.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, soy sauce and gochujang.
Spoon the rice into bowls and top with the tuna, kimchi and cucumber.
Scatter with sesame and scoop up bites with the nori squares.

title: Banh mi-style tofu sandwich
steps: Toss the carrot and cucumber with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt for a quick pickle.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, then add the soy sauce to glaze.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha and spread inside the split baguettes.
Fill with the tofu and pickles.

title: Halloumi & roasted pepper baguette
steps: Fry the halloumi in a dry pan for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Drizzle with the honey and sprinkle with chili.
Split the baguette and spread with hummus.
Fill with the peppers, halloumi and spinach.

title: Dutch baby pancake with berries
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) with the butter in an ovenproof frying pan.
Blend the eggs, flour, milk and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into the sizzling butter and bake for 18–20 minutes without opening the door, until puffed and golden.
Top with berries and yogurt and eat straight away.

title: Crispy potato & egg breakfast tacos
steps: Fry the potato in the oil with the paprika and salt for 12 minutes until crisp.
Pour in the eggs and scramble gently until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with the potato and eggs and top with cheddar and salsa.

title: Huevos rancheros
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 6 minutes.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites set.
Serve over warm tortillas.

title: Turkish-style menemen
steps: Cook the pepper and onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and chili and cook for 5 minutes until jammy.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until just set and still soft.
Serve straight from the pan with toast.

title: Masala omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with the onion, tomato, cilantro, spices and salt.
Melt half the butter in a frying pan and pour in half the egg.
Cook for 2 minutes, flip and cook for 1 minute. Repeat with the rest.
Serve with toast.

title: Savory rice congee with jammy egg
steps: Simmer the rice with 900 ml water, the bouillon and ginger for 25 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Meanwhile, boil the eggs for 6½ minutes, then cool and peel.
Season the congee with the soy sauce.
Top with halved eggs, spring onion, chili and peanuts.

title: Bacon, egg & cheese toastie
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, then fry the eggs in the same pan with broken yolks until set.
Layer the cheese, bacon and egg between the bread.
Butter the outsides and press in the pan for 3 minutes on each side until golden and melted.
Cut in half and serve with ketchup.

title: Zucchini fritters with yogurt
steps: Mix the zucchini, eggs, flour, feta and spring onion — squeezing the zucchini dry keeps them crisp.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes on each side until golden.
Season the yogurt with a pinch of salt.
Serve the fritters with the yogurt.

title: Cinnamon roll baked oats
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Blend the oats, banana, egg, milk, baking powder, half the cinnamon and half the maple syrup until smooth.
Pour into two small dishes, swirl in the rest of the cinnamon and maple syrup, and bake for 25 minutes.
Loosen the cream cheese with a splash of milk and spread over the warm oats like icing.

title: Banana oat breakfast muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Blend the oats, bananas, eggs, yogurt, maple syrup, baking powder and cinnamon.
Stir in the chocolate and divide between the cases.
Bake for 20–22 minutes until risen and golden. Keep for 4 days in a tin.

title: Savory cottage cheese breakfast bowl
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into bowls.
Top with the cucumber and tomato.
Mix the sesame seeds, garlic powder and chili and sprinkle over with the oil.
Scoop up with the rice cakes.

title: Kimchi cheese omelette
steps: Fry the kimchi in half the butter for 2 minutes, then set aside.
Melt the rest of the butter and pour in half the egg, swirling to cover the pan.
When almost set, add half the kimchi and cheese, fold and slide out. Repeat.
Scatter with spring onion and serve with toast.

title: Apple cinnamon pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, egg and milk into a thick batter, then stir in the apple.
Melt a little butter in a non-stick pan over a medium heat.
Cook spoonfuls for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, then flip for 1 minute.
Stack with yogurt and a dusting of cinnamon.

title: Green spinach banana pancakes
steps: Blend the spinach, banana, eggs, oats, milk and baking powder until bright green and smooth.
Wipe a non-stick pan with a little oil.
Cook small pancakes for 2 minutes on each side.
Serve with yogurt.

title: Warm berry crumble yogurt bowl
steps: Simmer the berries with half the maple syrup for 5 minutes until jammy.
In another pan, toast the oats in the butter with the cinnamon and the rest of the maple syrup until golden.
Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Top with the warm berries and the crumble.

title: Baked avocado egg boats
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Scoop out a little avocado to widen each hole and sit the halves in a small dish.
Crack an egg into each, top with cheddar, chili and salt and bake for 15 minutes until the whites set.
Serve with toast.

title: PB & J overnight oats
steps: Simmer the berries with the maple syrup for 5 minutes, mashing into a quick jam.
Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and peanut butter together.
Layer the oats and jam in two jars and chill overnight.
Top with an extra swirl of peanut butter.

title: Tortilla breakfast pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and put the tortillas on a lined tray.
Spread with passata and scatter with spinach, ham and mozzarella, leaving a gap in the middle.
Crack an egg into the middle of each.
Bake for 8–10 minutes until the egg white is set, then sprinkle with chili.

title: Breakfast pita pockets with eggs & hummus
steps: Scramble the eggs in the butter until just set.
Warm the pittas and split them open.
Spread the inside with hummus.
Fill with eggs, cucumber, tomato and a pinch of paprika.

title: Tropical mango coconut overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, coconut milk, milk and yogurt together.
Fold in half the mango and the lime zest.
Split between jars and chill overnight.
Top with the rest of the mango and a squeeze of lime.

title: Frozen yogurt peanut caramel bites
steps: Mix the yogurt with the honey and spoon into 12 mini cupcake cases.
Top each with a little peanut butter and some peanuts.
Freeze for 2 hours, dip the tops in melted chocolate and freeze for 10 minutes more.

title: Baked cinnamon apples with oat crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Rub the oats, butter, cinnamon and maple syrup together and pile into the apple halves.
Bake for 25 minutes until soft, and serve with yogurt.

title: Banana chocolate mug cake
steps: Mix the banana, egg, flour, baking powder and peanut butter in a large mug.
Stir in most of the chocolate and press the rest on top.
Microwave for 90 seconds to 2 minutes until just set. Share between two.

title: Cottage cheese pepper boats
steps: Mix the cottage cheese with the garlic powder.
Spoon into the pepper boats.
Sprinkle with chili and sesame.

title: Air-fryer mozzarella bites

ingredients.note: cut into cubes and frozen for 20 minutes

steps: Mix the breadcrumbs with the herbs.
Dip the frozen mozzarella in egg, then crumbs, then egg and crumbs again.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 5–6 minutes until golden, and serve with warm passata for dipping.

title: Air-fryer pizza rice cakes
steps: Spread the rice cakes with passata and top with mozzarella, olives and oregano.
Air-fry at 180°C (350°F) for 3–4 minutes until the cheese melts.
Eat straight away while crisp.

title: Everything-seasoning boiled eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Mix the sesame, garlic powder, onion powder, chili and salt.
Halve the eggs and dip the cut sides in the seasoning.

title: Quick cucumber kimchi
steps: Toss the cucumber with the salt and leave for 10 minutes, then drain.
Mix the gochujang, garlic, fish sauce and sugar and toss with the cucumber.
Scatter with spring onion and sesame and eat with rice cakes, or chill for up to 2 days.

title: Marinated feta & olives
steps: Toss the feta and olives with the oil, lemon zest, oregano, chili and garlic in a jar.
Leave for at least 30 minutes, or up to 3 days in the fridge.
Serve with cucumber sticks.

title: Grape & cheddar skewers
steps: Thread the grapes and cheddar cubes onto small skewers.
Serve with a few walnuts on the side.

title: Crunchy parmesan crisps
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a tray.
Make 8 small piles of parmesan, flatten slightly and sprinkle with herbs and chili.
Bake for 6–7 minutes until golden and lacy, then cool to crisp up.

title: Air-fryer sweet potato rounds with yogurt dip
steps: Toss the sweet potato with the oil, paprika and salt.
Air-fry at 190°C (375°F) for 12–15 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp at the edges.
Mix the yogurt with the lime juice and serve for dipping.

title: Chocolate-dipped frozen grapes
steps: Dip each grape halfway into the melted chocolate.
Sprinkle with sesame and lay on a lined tray.
Freeze for 1 hour until icy.

title: Hummus cucumber cups
steps: Scoop a little out of each cucumber round with a teaspoon to make cups.
Fill with hummus.
Finish with a drizzle of oil and a pinch of paprika.

title: Spicy sesame cucumber salad
steps: Slice the cucumber as thinly as you can into a lidded container.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, chili and sugar.
Close the lid, shake hard and top with sesame seeds.

title: Sticky sesame chicken
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, adding the broccoli for the last 4, then drain.
Toss the chicken in 2 tbsp cornstarch.
Fry in the oil over a medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until crisp and cooked through. Set aside.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, the rest of the cornstarch and 3 tbsp water.
Pour into the pan and bubble for 1 minute until thick, then toss the chicken back in with most of the sesame seeds.
Serve over the rice and broccoli with spring onions and the rest of the sesame.

title: Mapo-style tofu with pork
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Brown the pork in the oil for 6 minutes until crisp.
Add the garlic, ginger, gochujang and chili flakes and fry for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Slide in the tofu and simmer gently for 5 minutes without stirring too much.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water until glossy, and serve over rice with spring onions.

title: Char siu-style pork with rice & greens
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix the hoisin, honey, soy sauce, five-spice and garlic and coat the pork, keeping 2 tbsp aside.
Roast on a lined tray for 22–25 minutes, brushing with the saved glaze halfway, until sticky and just cooked.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Steam or boil the bok choy for 3 minutes and toss with the sesame oil.
Rest the pork for 5 minutes, slice and serve over rice with the greens, spooning over the tray juices.

title: Salt & pepper chicken
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Mix the salt, pepper and five-spice.
Toss the chicken in the cornstarch and half the spice mix.
Fry in the oil over a high heat for 7 minutes until crisp and golden, then set aside.
Stir-fry the onion, peppers, garlic and chili for 3 minutes.
Toss the chicken back in with the rest of the spice mix and serve with the rice.

title: Singapore-style noodles
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6 minutes, then drain.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil, then set aside.
Stir-fry the shrimp, pepper and onion in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the curry powder and ham for 30 seconds.
Toss in the noodles, soy sauce and eggs until evenly yellow.
Add the bean sprouts and spring onions and toss for 1 minute.

title: Hainanese-style poached chicken rice
steps: Simmer 1.2 litres water with the bouillon, sliced ginger and half the spring onions, add the chicken and poach gently for 15 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and keep 650 ml of the broth.
Fry the rice with half the garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 1 minute, add the saved broth, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes — the broth makes the rice the star.
Mix the grated ginger, the rest of the garlic and spring onions with a pinch of salt and 1 tbsp hot oil for a ginger sauce.
Mix the soy sauce, lime juice and chili.
Slice the chicken and serve on the rice with cucumber, both sauces and a cup of the hot broth.

title: Red curry pork & green bean stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the pork and cook for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until crispy.
Add the green beans and a splash of water and stir-fry for 4 minutes until just tender.
Season with the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and stir in the basil.
Fry the eggs until crispy at the edges and serve on top of the rice and pork.

title: Tom kha-style coconut chicken soup
steps: Simmer 800 ml water with the bouillon, ginger and curry paste for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and bring back to a gentle simmer.
Add the chicken and mushrooms and simmer for 8 minutes until cooked.
Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 8 minutes, then drain into bowls.
Season the soup with the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar — it should taste sour, salty and a little sweet.
Ladle over the noodles.

title: Vietnamese-style caramel pork
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Melt the sugar in a dry deep pan over a medium heat until it turns a deep amber caramel.
Carefully add 4 tbsp water, the fish sauce and soy sauce and stir until smooth.
Add the oil, garlic, onion and pork and simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce is sticky.
Season with plenty of black pepper.
Serve over rice with cucumber, spring onions and chili.

title: Nasi goreng
steps: Cook the rice for 12 minutes, drain and spread out to steam dry.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over a high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, onion and chili and cook for 2 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, honey and ketchup into a sweet soy sauce, add with the rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes until sticky.
Fry the eggs in another pan until crispy at the edges.
Serve the rice topped with the eggs and cucumber on the side.

title: Laksa-style shrimp noodle soup
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool and peel.
Fry the curry paste and curry powder in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, 700 ml boiling water, the bouillon, fish sauce and sugar and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and simmer for 3 minutes until pink.
Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 8 minutes and drain into bowls.
Ladle over the soup and top with sprouts, halved eggs and lime.

title: Yaki udon with pork & cabbage
steps: Loosen the udon in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Fry the pork in the oil over a high heat for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the cabbage, carrot and mushrooms and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, Worcestershire and honey.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes.
Serve topped with spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Air-fryer tonkatsu pork with cabbage
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Season the pork with salt, dust in flour, dip in egg, then press into the breadcrumbs.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 12 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Mix the ketchup and Worcestershire into a quick tonkatsu sauce.
Pile the shredded cabbage onto plates — shred it as finely as you can.
Slice the pork and serve with the rice, cabbage and sauce.

title: Air-fryer chicken karaage bowl
steps: Marinate the chicken in 2 tbsp soy sauce, the ginger and garlic for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the chicken in the cornstarch until coated.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 14 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha.
Serve over rice with cabbage, the spicy mayo, lemon wedges and spring onions, drizzled with the rest of the soy.

title: Cheesy dakgalbi-style spicy chicken
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, honey and garlic and coat the chicken.
Heat the oil in a large pan and add the chicken, cabbage and onion.
Stir-fry for 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is sticky.
Scatter over the mozzarella, cover for 2 minutes to melt.
Sprinkle with sesame and serve with the rice.

title: Beef bulgogi rice bowl
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey and garlic and marinate the beef for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the sesame oil in a very hot pan and cook the onion for 2 minutes.
Add the beef in batches and sear for 2 minutes until caramelised.
Spoon over the rice.
Serve with cucumber, spring onions and sesame.

title: Kimchi stew with pork & tofu
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Brown the pork in the oil in a deep pan for 5 minutes.
Add the kimchi, onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes — frying the kimchi deepens the flavour.
Stir in the gochujang, then 900 ml boiling water, the bouillon and soy sauce, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Slide in the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes more.
Scatter with spring onions and serve with the rice.

title: Palak paneer
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the spinach with a splash of water until hot, then blend until smooth.
Fry the paneer in half the oil until golden, then set aside.
Cook the onion in the rest of the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute, and the tomato for 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach, cream and salt and simmer for 3 minutes.
Fold in the paneer and serve with the rice.

title: Chicken jalfrezi
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Brown the chicken in half the oil for 5 minutes, then set aside.
Fry the onions and peppers in the rest of the oil over a high heat for 5 minutes until charred at the edges.
Add the garlic, ginger, chili and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chicken and salt and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Serve with the rice and cilantro.

title: Tandoori-style chicken traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix half the yogurt with the spices, garlic, lemon juice and salt and coat the chicken.
Toss the cauliflower and onions with the oil on a large tray and add the chicken.
Roast for 30 minutes until the chicken is charred and cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Mix the rest of the yogurt with the cucumber and serve alongside.

title: Rajma kidney bean curry
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Fry the cumin in the oil for 30 seconds, then add the onion for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, salt and 200 ml water.
Simmer for 15 minutes, crushing some of the beans to thicken.
Serve over the rice with cilantro.

title: Spiced egg curry
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Cook the onions in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, coconut milk and salt.
Simmer for 8 minutes, then add the spinach and the eggs, halved.
Warm through and serve with the rice and cilantro.

title: Chicken & chickpea tagine with couscous
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a deep pan for 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, 300 ml water, 1 tsp bouillon, the chickpeas, raisins and honey.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Pour 350 ml boiling water with the rest of the bouillon over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Serve the tagine over the couscous.

title: Lebanese-style spiced chicken & rice
steps: Poach the chicken in the stock for 15 minutes, then lift out and shred, keeping 600 ml of stock.
Brown the beef and onion in the butter for 7 minutes with the cinnamon, cumin and salt.
Stir in the rice, then the saved stock.
Cover and cook on a low heat for 15 minutes until tender.
Toast the cashews in a dry pan until golden.
Pile the rice onto a plate, top with the chicken, cashews and parsley, and serve with yogurt and cucumber.

title: Greek-style baked white beans with feta
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Cook the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, oregano and cinnamon.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, beans and 150 ml water.
Tip into a baking dish and crumble over the feta.
Bake for 25 minutes until bubbling and golden at the edges.
Scatter with parsley and serve with warm baguette.

title: Briam Greek roast vegetables with feta
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss all the vegetables and garlic with the oil, oregano and salt on your largest tray — small pieces and space are what make this fast.
Roast for 20 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes and roast for 15 minutes more until soft and caramelised.
Crumble over the feta.
Serve with bread.

title: Greek stuffed peppers with rice & feta
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and roast the pepper halves for 10 minutes while you make the filling.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, rice and oregano.
Add the tomatoes, 300 ml water and the bouillon and simmer for 12 minutes until the rice is nearly tender.
Stir in the chickpeas and most of the feta.
Fill the peppers and bake for 15 minutes.
Crumble over the rest of the feta to serve.

title: Chicken cacciatore
steps: Season the chicken with salt and brown in the oil in a deep pan for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the onion, peppers and mushrooms for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and herbs, then the tomatoes, stock and olives.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until tender.
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, then drain.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the pasta with parsley.

title: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes. Save a mug of water before draining.
Fry the bacon with the whole garlic clove until crisp, then discard the garlic.
Whisk the eggs with most of the parmesan and the pepper.
Take the bacon pan off the heat and add the spaghetti and peas.
Pour in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water and toss quickly until silky, not scrambled.
Serve with the rest of the parmesan and more pepper.

title: Pasta e fagioli
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and herbs for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, 1 litre boiling water and the bouillon, then mash a few beans to thicken.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then add the pasta and simmer for 10 minutes until tender.
Season and loosen with a splash of water if needed.
Serve with parmesan and crusty bread.

title: Gnocchi alla sorrentina
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Cook the garlic in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 1 minute, then add the passata, herbs and salt and simmer for 8 minutes.
Cook the gnocchi in boiling water for 2 minutes until they float, then drain.
Stir the gnocchi and half the basil into the sauce.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake for 12 minutes until bubbling.
Scatter with the rest of the basil and serve with an arugula salad.

title: Lemon butter chicken with spaghetti
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, saving a mug of water before draining.
Season the chicken with salt and dust in the flour.
Fry in the oil and 1 tbsp butter for 4 minutes on each side until golden and cooked. Set aside.
Add the garlic, stock and lemon juice to the pan and bubble for 3 minutes, then stir in the rest of the butter.
Toss the spaghetti and spinach in half the sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Slice the chicken, lay on top and spoon over the rest of the sauce, parsley and parmesan.

title: Pasta alla norma
steps: Fry the eggplant in 3 tbsp oil over a medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until golden and soft.
Push to one side, add the rest of the oil, garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in salted boiling water, then drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and most of the basil.
Serve with parmesan and the rest of the basil.

title: Vegetable paella
steps: Cook the onion and peppers in the oil in a wide pan for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, paprika and turmeric for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice, then the tomatoes, 900 ml boiling water and the bouillon.
Simmer without stirring for 15 minutes — not stirring is what gives paella its crispy base.
Scatter over the beans, peas and chickpeas, cover and cook for 8 minutes until the rice is tender.
Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Patatas bravas with fried eggs
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and salt and roast for 35 minutes until crisp.
Cook the garlic, paprika and chili in the rest of the oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and vinegar and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Mix 1 tbsp of the sauce into the mayonnaise.
Fry the eggs until crisp at the edges.
Pile the potatoes onto plates, spoon over the bravas sauce and garlic mayo and top with the eggs and parsley.

title: Carne asada rice bowls
steps: Mix the juice of 2 limes, the garlic, spices, oil and salt and marinate the steak for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain and toss with half the cilantro.
Mix the tomato, onion, the rest of the cilantro and the juice of the last lime for a pico de gallo.
Sear the steak in a very hot pan for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
Serve over the rice with warm beans and pico de gallo.

title: One-pot taco soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper for 8 minutes.
Stir in the spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, sweetcorn, 700 ml boiling water and the bouillon and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toast the tortilla strips in a dry pan until crisp.
Taste and season with salt.
Serve topped with cheddar and the crispy strips.

title: Street corn chicken bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Rub the chicken with the spices and salt and cook in the oil for 6 minutes on each side, then slice.
Char the corn in the hot pan for 6 minutes until blackened in spots.
Mix the mayonnaise, yogurt and juice of 1 lime, then toss with the corn, feta and onion.
Fill bowls with rice, chicken and the street corn.
Finish with cilantro, chili and lime wedges.

title: Chicken pot pie skillet with biscuit topping
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Cook the onion, carrot, celery and chicken in 1 tbsp butter in an ovenproof pan for 8 minutes.
Stir in 2 tbsp flour and the thyme, then whisk in the stock and 150 ml milk and simmer until thick. Add the peas.
Rub the rest of the butter into the rest of the flour with the baking powder and salt, then stir in the cheese and the rest of the milk to a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls of the dough over the filling.
Bake for 20 minutes until the biscuits are risen and golden.

title: Mini turkey meatloaves with mash
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix the turkey, onion, breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire, garlic powder and salt and shape into 8 mini loaves on a lined tray.
Brush with the ketchup and bake for 25 minutes until glazed and cooked through.
Meanwhile, boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with the milk and butter.
Steam the green beans for 4 minutes.
Serve the meatloaves with the mash and beans.

title: One-pot chili mac
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large pan for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, beans and stock and bring to the boil.
Add the pasta and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring often, until tender.
Stir in most of the cheddar until melted.
Top with the rest of the cheese and spring onions.

title: White chicken chili
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, chili and spices.
Add the whole chicken breasts, 800 ml boiling water and the bouillon and simmer for 15 minutes.
Lift out and shred the chicken.
Mash half the beans and add them all to the pot with the corn and chicken.
Stir in the cream cheese and lime juice until creamy.
Serve with cilantro and toasted tortilla strips.

title: Air-fryer fish goujons, chips & mushy peas
steps: Toss the chips with the oil and salt and air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes, shaking twice. Keep warm.
Dust the fish in flour, dip in egg, then press into the breadcrumbs mixed with the paprika.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 8–10 minutes until golden and flaky.
Meanwhile, boil the peas for 3 minutes, drain and mash with the butter and a pinch of salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with a squeeze of lemon.
Serve the fish and chips with the mushy peas, lemon mayo and lemon wedges.

title: One-pot lamb, potato & carrot stew
steps: Brown the lamb in a deep pan for 6 minutes until crisp, then spoon off most of the fat.
Add the onions and carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then the Worcestershire, thyme, bouillon, salt and 600 ml boiling water.
Add the potatoes, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until tender and the gravy is thick.
