Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Serve in bowls with plenty of gravy.

title: Huli huli-style chicken & rice
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Whisk the ketchup, soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic and toss the chicken in half of it.
Roast on a lined tray for 25–30 minutes, brushing with the rest of the sauce twice, until sticky and charred.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Serve the chicken over rice with the slaw and spring onions.

title: Elote-style corn & chickpea salad
steps: Char the corn in a dry pan over a high heat for 6 minutes until blackened in spots.
Mix the mayonnaise, yogurt, lime juice and chili powder.
Toss the corn, chickpeas and onion in the dressing.
Top with feta and cilantro and serve with toasted tortillas.

title: Curried chicken salad sandwich
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 minutes, then cool and dice.
Mix the yogurt, mayonnaise and curry powder.
Fold in the chicken, raisins, celery and spring onion.
Fill the bread with lettuce and the curried chicken.

title: Chicken & avocado club sandwich
steps: Cook the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes on each side, then slice. Fry the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer toast, chicken and lettuce, then toast, bacon, avocado and tomato, then toast.
Hold with skewers and cut into triangles.

title: Tuna onigirazu sushi sandwich
steps: Cook the rice for 12 minutes, drain and mix with the vinegar, then cool slightly.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise and sriracha.
Lay a nori sheet diamond-wise, put a square of rice in the middle, then lettuce, tuna, cucumber and more rice.
Fold the corners over to make a parcel, wrap tightly and cut in half.

title: Roast cauliflower salad with tahini
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Toss the cauliflower and chickpeas with the oil, spices and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and 4 tbsp water.
Toss the arugula, raisins and parsley with the warm roast tray.
Drizzle generously with the tahini sauce.

title: Quicker French onion soup with cheesy toast
steps: Cook the onions in the butter with the sugar, thyme and salt over a medium-high heat for 18 minutes, adding a splash of water whenever they catch — this speeds up the browning.
Stir in the flour, then 1.2 litres boiling water, the bouillon and Worcestershire, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Top the baguette slices with cheddar and grill until bubbling.
Ladle the soup into bowls and float the cheesy toasts on top.

title: Chinese-style chicken & sweetcorn soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the ginger, chicken and corn for 10 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and the cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water until slightly thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the egg while stirring gently so it forms silky ribbons.
Finish with sesame oil and spring onions, with toast on the side.

title: Hot & sour tofu soup
steps: Simmer 800 ml water with the bouillon, mushrooms and noodles for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and chili.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water until thickened.
Drizzle in the egg while stirring, then top with spring onions.

title: Spicy peanut & sweet potato soup
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and chili.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, 900 ml boiling water and the bouillon and simmer for 18 minutes.
Stir in the peanut butter and blend half the soup, then stir it back in.
Add the spinach until wilted and serve with peanuts and lime.

title: Curried cauliflower soup with crispy chickpeas
steps: Cook the onion in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, then add the curry powder.
Add the cauliflower, potato and stock and simmer for 18 minutes, then blend with the coconut milk.
Fry the chickpeas in the rest of the oil with the paprika for 6 minutes until crisp.
Serve the soup topped with crispy chickpeas and cilantro, with warm naan.

title: Loaded hummus bowl with spiced beef
steps: Brown the beef in the oil for 7 minutes until crisp, adding the garlic and spices for the last minute.
Swoosh the hummus over plates.
Pile on the spiced beef, tomato and cucumber and squeeze over the lemon.
Serve with warm pita for scooping.

title: Tuna-stuffed avocados
steps: Scoop a little flesh from each avocado half and dice it.
Mix with the tuna, yogurt, lemon juice, onion and sweetcorn.
Pile back into the avocado halves and dust with paprika.
Serve with rice cakes.

title: Air-fryer halloumi fries with salad
steps: Toss the halloumi in the cornstarch and paprika.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 8–10 minutes until golden.
Toss the cucumber, tomato and spinach.
Serve the fries with the salad, warm pita, yogurt and sweet chili sauce for dipping.

title: Pea, feta & mint frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and soften the spring onions in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 2 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the salt and stir in the peas, feta and mint.
Pour into the pan, cook for 3 minutes until the edges set, then bake for 15 minutes.
Cut into wedges and serve warm or cold with arugula and toast.

title: Spanish potato tortilla
steps: Microwave the potato slices with a splash of water, covered, for 8 minutes until just tender.
Fry the onion and potatoes in the oil over a medium heat for 6 minutes without browning much.
Beat the eggs with the salt, stir in the potatoes and onion, pour back into the pan and cook over a low heat for 5 minutes, then flip onto a plate and slide back for 3 minutes.
Cut into wedges and serve warm or cold with a lettuce and tomato salad.

title: Mezze lunch plate
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, then cool, peel and halve.
Warm the pittas and cut into strips.
Spoon the hummus onto plates and drizzle with the oil and paprika.
Arrange the eggs, cucumber, tomato, feta and peppers around it.

title: Ploughman's lunch box
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, then cool, peel and halve.
Slice the bread.
Pack the cheddar, ham, apple, eggs, celery and grapes into boxes.
Add a dab of mustard and the bread.

title: Leek & potato soup
steps: Soften the leeks and onion in the butter for 8 minutes without browning.
Add the potatoes, stock and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir in the milk.
Serve with cheddar on top and toast on the side.

title: Smoky chorizo & bean soup
steps: Fry the chorizo in a dry pan for 3 minutes until it releases its oil.
Add the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in the kale.
Serve with crusty bread.

title: Cheesy bean & corn tortilla bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix the beans, sweetcorn, spinach, cumin and two-thirds of the salsa.
Layer tortillas, bean mix and cheese in a round dish, finishing with a tortilla, the rest of the salsa and cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes, then cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and cilantro.

title: Pan-fried croque madame
steps: Spread two slices of bread with mustard and top with ham and most of the cheese, then close the sandwiches.
Butter the outsides and fry over a medium heat for 3 minutes on each side, pressing down.
Scatter the rest of the cheese on top in the pan and cover for 1 minute to melt.
Fry the eggs and sit one on each sandwich.

title: Lighter eggs Benedict
steps: Whisk the yogurt, mustard and lemon juice and warm gently in a small pan (don't boil) for a quick hollandaise.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes.
Toast the bread.
Layer the toast with ham and eggs and spoon over the sauce with a pinch of paprika.

title: Chilaquiles with fried eggs
steps: Toss the tortilla triangles with the oil and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 8 minutes until crisp.
Warm the salsa with the chili powder in a frying pan.
Toss the chips in the salsa until just coated, and fry the eggs in another pan.
Top with the eggs, feta and onion and eat straight away.

title: Sausage & potato breakfast hash
steps: Fry the potatoes in the oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the sausage, onion, pepper and paprika and cook for 8 minutes.
Make 2 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes.
Scatter with spring onion.

title: Full English-style traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss the sausages and tomatoes with the oil on a large tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Mix the beans with the passata and a pinch of salt and spoon onto one corner of the tray.
Make 4 gaps, crack in the eggs and bake for 8–10 minutes until the whites set.
Serve with toast.

title: Tamago sando egg sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, sugar, milk and salt until creamy, then chop and fold in the whites.
Spread thickly between the bread.
Press gently, cut off the crusts and slice in half.

title: Snickers-style overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and half the peanut butter together.
Split between two jars and chill overnight.
Spread the rest of the peanut butter over the top.
Drizzle with melted chocolate and scatter with peanuts.

title: Banana chocolate crepes
steps: Blend the flour, egg and milk into a thin batter and rest for 5 minutes.
Wipe a non-stick pan with butter and swirl in a thin layer of batter.
Cook for 1 minute, flip for 30 seconds and repeat to make 4–6 crepes.
Fill with banana, fold and drizzle with chocolate.

title: Make-ahead berry French toast bake
steps: Butter a baking dish and add the bread and berries.
Whisk the eggs, milk, 2 tbsp maple syrup and cinnamon and pour over. Chill overnight.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 35 minutes until puffed and golden.
Drizzle with the rest of the maple syrup.

title: Honey walnut granola with yogurt
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (325°F).
Mix the oats, walnuts, cinnamon, honey and oil and spread on a lined tray.
Bake for 25 minutes, stirring once, then leave to cool — it crisps as it cools.
Serve over yogurt with berries. Keep the rest in a jar for 2 weeks.

title: Spinach & feta savory muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and line an 8-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk, yogurt and oil, then fold in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Fold in the spinach and feta and divide between the cases.
Bake for 20–22 minutes until risen and golden. Keep for 3 days.

title: Two-ingredient dough flatbread with eggs
steps: Mix the flour, yogurt and baking powder into a soft dough, then roll into 2 thin rounds.
Cook each in a dry pan for 2 minutes on each side until puffed and charred.
Scramble the eggs in the butter with the spinach.
Pile onto the flatbreads with feta and chili.

title: Two-ingredient dough bagels
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Mix the flour, yogurt, baking powder and salt into a dough and split into 4.
Roll each into a rope, join into a ring, brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden. Make a batch at the weekend — they keep for 2 days.
Serve split with cream cheese and cucumber.

title: Healthy banana bread
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a loaf tin.
Whisk the bananas, eggs, yogurt, maple syrup and oil, then fold in the flour, oats, baking powder and cinnamon.
Bake for 45–50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool before slicing. It keeps for 4 days wrapped up.

title: Apple oat breakfast bars
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a square tin.
Mix everything together.
Press into the tin.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden, then cool and cut into 8 bars.

title: Mango coconut breakfast rice pudding
steps: Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, milk, maple syrup and cinnamon for 25 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Toss the mango with the lime juice.
Spoon the rice pudding into bowls.
Top with the mango.

title: Peanut butter banana breakfast quesadilla
steps: Spread the tortillas with peanut butter.
Lay the banana over half of each, sprinkle with cinnamon and fold.
Toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes on each side.
Cut into wedges and serve with yogurt and honey.

title: Savory cheese & tomato French toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, parmesan and pepper.
Soak the bread in the mixture for 1 minute on each side.
Fry in the butter for 3 minutes on each side until golden.
Blister the tomatoes in the same pan and pile on top.

title: Fluffy cottage cheese scrambled eggs
steps: Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over a low heat.
Stir the eggs slowly until softly set and fluffy.
Serve on toast with spring onion.

title: Breakfast nachos
steps: Toss the tortilla triangles with the oil and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 8 minutes until crisp.
Softly scramble the eggs.
Spoon the eggs and beans over the chips, scatter with cheddar and bake for 4 minutes.
Top with salsa and spring onions.

title: Baked cottage cheese crisps
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a tray with baking paper.
Spread teaspoons of cottage cheese thinly on the tray and sprinkle with herbs and chili.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until golden and crisp, then cool on the tray.

title: No-bake peanut oat bars
steps: Warm the peanut butter and honey in the microwave for 30 seconds and stir into the oats.
Press into a small lined tin and drizzle with the chocolate and peanuts.
Chill for 1 hour, then cut into 8 bars.

title: Tzatziki with baked pita chips
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and bake the pita triangles with half the oil for 8 minutes.
Mix the yogurt, cucumber, garlic, mint and lemon juice.
Drizzle with the rest of the oil and serve with the chips.

title: Healthier peanut butter cups
steps: Melt the chocolate in the microwave and spoon a little into 8 mini cupcake cases.
Mix the peanut butter, honey and yogurt, add a spoonful to each and top with the rest of the chocolate.
Chill for 30 minutes until set.

title: Tomato bruschetta
steps: Toast the baguette slices in a hot oven at 200°C (400°F) for 5 minutes, then rub with the cut garlic.
Mix the tomatoes, basil, oil, balsamic and salt.
Spoon onto the toasts just before eating.

title: Ham & cheese pinwheels
steps: Spread the tortillas with cream cheese.
Cover with ham, spinach and cheddar and roll up tightly.
Chill for 10 minutes, then slice into 1 cm pinwheels.

title: Air-fryer sweet chili halloumi bites
steps: Toss the halloumi in the cornstarch.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 8 minutes until golden.
Toss with the sweet chili sauce and lime juice and finish with sesame and spring onion.

title: Microwave potato crisps
steps: Pat the potato slices dry and toss with the oil.
Lay in a single layer on baking paper and microwave for 3–4 minutes until crisp, turning once. Repeat in batches.
Sprinkle with salt and paprika.

title: Air-fryer cinnamon sugar tortilla chips
steps: Brush the tortilla triangles with the butter and toss in the cinnamon and sugar.
Air-fry at 180°C (350°F) for 4–5 minutes until crisp.
Serve with yogurt mashed with the berries for dipping.

title: Honey yogurt fruit dip platter
steps: Whisk the yogurt, honey, cinnamon and peanut butter.
Arrange the fruit around the dip.
Dip and eat straight away.

title: Air-fryer crispy broccoli parmesan bites
steps: Toss the broccoli with the oil, garlic powder and half the parmesan.
Air-fry at 190°C (375°F) for 8–10 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Toss with the rest of the parmesan and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Maple paprika mixed nuts
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C (340°F).
Toss the nuts with the maple syrup, paprika and salt and spread on a lined tray.
Roast for 12 minutes, stirring once, then cool to crisp up.

title: Chocolate peanut rice cake bites
steps: Melt the chocolate with the peanut butter in the microwave.
Dip the rice cake pieces and lay on a lined tray.
Chill for 15 minutes until set.

title: Smashed avocado & edamame rice cakes
steps: Boil the edamame for 3 minutes, then drain and cool.
Smash with the avocado, lime juice and soy sauce.
Spread over the rice cakes and finish with sesame and chili.

title: Air-fryer cinnamon banana chips
steps: Toss the banana slices in the lemon juice and cinnamon.
Air-fry in a single layer at 150°C (300°F) for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway.
Cool for 5 minutes to crisp up.

title: Unstuffed cabbage roll skillet
steps: Heat the oil in a deep lidded pan over a high heat and press the beef down in one layer. Leave it for 4 minutes to brown, then break it up.
Add the onion for 4 minutes, then the garlic, paprika and thyme for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes until it darkens.
Add the tomatoes, rice, 500 ml boiling water, the bouillon and salt, then pile the cabbage on top.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring once, until the rice is tender and the cabbage silky.
Stir in the vinegar and sugar and serve with sour cream.

title: Spinach & cheese lasagne roll-ups
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Soak the lasagne sheets in just-boiled water for 5 minutes until bendy.
Mix the passata with the garlic, herbs and salt and spread half in a baking dish.
Mix the cottage cheese, spinach and half the parmesan.
Spread each sheet with filling, roll up and sit seam-side down in the sauce.
Spoon over the rest of the sauce and top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 30 minutes until bubbling and the pasta is tender.

title: Chicken parmesan meatballs
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix the chicken, breadcrumbs, half the parmesan, the egg, a third of the garlic, half the herbs and the salt. Roll into 16 meatballs with wet hands.
Roast on an oiled tray for 12 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile, cook the rest of the garlic and the chili in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 1 minute, add the passata and the rest of the herbs, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Nestle the meatballs into the sauce, top with mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan, and bake for 10 minutes until the cheese is blistered.
Cook the spaghetti and toss with a few spoons of the sauce.
Serve the meatballs over the spaghetti with torn basil.

title: Swedish meatballs with mash & gravy
steps: Mix the beef, onion, breadcrumbs, 3 tbsp milk, the egg and salt and roll into 20 small meatballs.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with 1 tbsp butter and the rest of the milk.
Meanwhile, brown the meatballs in 1 tbsp butter for 8 minutes, shaking the pan, then set aside.
Melt the rest of the butter in the same pan, whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute until nutty.
Whisk in 400 ml boiling water, the bouillon, Worcestershire and mustard and simmer until glossy.
Return the meatballs for 5 minutes and serve over the mash with lots of gravy.

title: Beef stroganoff with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Season the beef and sear in the oil over a very high heat in two batches, 1 minute per side, so it stays pink. Set aside.
Add the butter, onion and mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes until golden and dry.
Stir in the garlic and paprika, then the mustard, Worcestershire, bouillon and 200 ml water, and bubble for 3 minutes.
Take off the heat, stir in the sour cream and return the beef to warm through.
Serve over the rice with plenty of black pepper.

title: Steak frites with garlic herb butter
steps: Soak the fries in cold water for 10 minutes, then dry them really well — the secret to crisp fries.
Toss with half the oil and air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes. Salt straight away.
Mash the butter with the garlic and parsley.
Season the steak and sear in a smoking-hot pan with the rest of the oil for 3 minutes on each side.
Rest for 5 minutes under a spoon of the herb butter, then slice — one big steak is plenty for two.
Serve with the fries and a lettuce salad dressed with the mustard and resting juices.

title: Crispy doner-style lamb pittas
steps: Mix the lamb with the spices, salt and half the garlic.
Press it thinly over a large hot dry pan and leave for 5 minutes until a deep crust forms underneath.
Flip in pieces and cook for 5 minutes more, then break into thin crispy shreds — just like shaved doner.
Mix the yogurt with the rest of the garlic and a pinch of salt.
Warm the pittas.
Stuff with lamb, lettuce, onion, tomato, garlic sauce and hot sauce.

title: Crispy hoisin pork pancakes
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over a high heat and press the pork into one layer.
Leave for 5 minutes until a crisp brown crust forms, then break up and keep frying for 4 minutes until crispy.
Add the garlic and five-spice for 30 seconds.
Stir in 3 tbsp hoisin, the soy sauce and honey and toss until sticky and glossy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and cut each in half.
Spread each piece with a little hoisin, add pork, cucumber and spring onion, and roll up like a Peking duck pancake.
Scatter with sesame seeds.

title: Cashew chicken stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Toast the cashews in a dry wok for 3 minutes until golden, then tip out.
Heat the oil until smoking and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the pepper, onion and garlic for 3 minutes, then the rest of the soy, the hoisin and honey for 1 minute.
Toss through the cashews and spring onions and serve over the rice.

title: Firecracker turkey meatballs
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, half the garlic, half the spring onions and 1 tbsp soy sauce, and roll into 20 meatballs.
Roast on a lined tray for 15 minutes until golden.
Cook the rice, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes, then drain.
Simmer the hot sauce, honey, chili, the rest of the garlic and soy sauce for 3 minutes until sticky, then toss the meatballs in it.
Serve over the rice and broccoli with the rest of the spring onions and sesame.

title: Hot honey chorizo flatbread pizza
steps: Heat the oven to its highest setting, at least 240°C (465°F), with a tray inside.
Mix the flour, yogurt, baking powder and salt into a soft dough and knead for 1 minute. Split in two and roll out thinly.
Mix the passata with the oregano, garlic and a pinch of salt.
Carefully lay the bases on the hot tray and spread thinly with the sauce.
Top with mozzarella and chorizo and bake for 10–12 minutes until the base is crisp and the chorizo curls up.
Warm the honey with the chili flakes.
Drizzle the hot honey over the pizzas and top with arugula.

title: Two-ingredient dough margherita pizza
steps: Heat the oven to its highest setting, at least 240°C (465°F), with a tray inside.
Drain the tomatoes in a sieve for 5 minutes, then mix with the garlic, 1 tbsp oil and the salt — draining stops a soggy base.
Mix the flour, yogurt and baking powder into a soft dough, knead briefly, split in two and roll out thinly.
Lay the bases on the hot tray, spread with the tomato and dot with mozzarella.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until blistered and crisp underneath.
Finish with parmesan, lots of basil and the rest of the oil.

title: Ham, mushroom & cheese calzones
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Fry the mushrooms in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and dry.
Mix the flour, yogurt, baking powder and salt into a dough and split into 4. Roll each into a 20 cm circle.
Mix half the passata with the oregano and spread over one half of each circle, leaving a border.
Top with ham, mushrooms, spinach and mozzarella, fold over and crimp the edges tightly.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with parmesan, cut a small slit in each and bake for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.
Warm the rest of the passata for dipping.

title: Cheesy chicken & broccoli rice
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a deep lidded pan for 5 minutes, then add the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, 600 ml boiling water, the bouillon and salt, cover and simmer for 12 minutes.
Lay the broccoli on top, cover and cook for 5 minutes more.
Stir in the cream cheese, mustard and most of the cheddar until creamy.
Scatter with the rest of the cheese and cover for 1 minute to melt.
Serve straight from the pan.

title: Creamy chicken fajita pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, saving a mug of water before draining.
Toss the chicken with the spices and salt.
Sear the chicken in the oil over a high heat for 5 minutes until charred, then set aside.
Cook the peppers and onion in the same pan for 5 minutes until blistered at the edges.
Add the tomatoes and cream cheese and stir into a smoky, creamy sauce.
Toss in the pasta, chicken, cheddar and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with lime juice and cilantro.

title: Lemon garlic butter salmon pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, saving a mug of water before draining.
Season the salmon and cook in 1 tbsp butter for 4 minutes on each side, then flake into big chunks.
Melt the rest of the butter in the pan with the garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Add the spinach and the lemon zest and juice and stir until hot.
Toss in the spaghetti, parmesan and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Fold through the salmon gently and serve — two fillets go a long way this way.

title: Air-fryer crispy chicken burgers with slaw
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, hot sauce and salt for at least 10 minutes — the yogurt keeps it juicy.
Mix the breadcrumbs, paprika and garlic powder and press the chicken into them firmly.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 12–14 minutes, turning halfway, until deep golden and cooked through.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with 2 tbsp mayonnaise and the lime juice for a crunchy slaw.
Toast the buns cut-side down in a dry pan.
Build with mayonnaise, lettuce, crispy chicken and a pile of slaw.

title: Halloumi burgers with sweet chili mayo
steps: Toss the onion with the lime juice and a pinch of salt and leave for 5 minutes to quick-pickle.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sweet chili sauce.
Fry the halloumi in a dry pan over a medium-high heat for 2 minutes on each side until deeply golden.
Warm the roasted peppers in the same pan.
Toast the buns cut-side down.
Build with sweet chili mayo, arugula, two slices of halloumi, peppers, avocado and pickled onion.

title: Garlic butter steak & potato foil packets
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Par-boil the potatoes for 5 minutes, then drain well.
Mix the butter, garlic, paprika, thyme, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Toss the steak, potatoes and beans in the garlic butter.
Split between 4 large sheets of foil and fold into sealed packets.
Bake for 18–20 minutes so the steak stays juicy, then open carefully.

title: Moroccan lamb meatballs with couscous
steps: Mix the lamb with the grated onion, half the spices, a third of the garlic and the salt, and roll into 20 meatballs.
Brown them in the oil in a deep pan for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the diced onion for 5 minutes, then the rest of the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, honey and chickpeas, return the meatballs and simmer for 12 minutes.
Pour 350 ml boiling water and the bouillon over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, fluff and add the lemon zest.
Serve the meatballs over the couscous with yogurt and lemon wedges.

title: Cajun shrimp boil traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix the melted butter with the garlic, spices and salt.
Toss the potatoes and corn with half the Cajun butter on a large tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the sausage and roast for 8 minutes.
Toss the shrimp in the rest of the Cajun butter, add to the tray and roast for 6 minutes until pink.
Squeeze over the lemon and serve straight from the tray.

title: No-stir baked chicken & mushroom risotto
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Brown the chicken and mushrooms in the oil and 1 tbsp butter in an ovenproof pan for 7 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic and thyme for 3 minutes, then stir in the rice for 1 minute until glossy.
Pour in the hot stock, cover and bake for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach, parmesan and the rest of the butter vigorously for 1 minute — this makes it creamy.
Finish with lemon juice and pepper and serve straight away.

title: One-pot butternut squash mac & cheese

ingredients.note: peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Simmer the squash and garlic in the milk with the salt in a large pan for 12 minutes until very soft.
Mash it right in the pan with a potato masher until smooth — no blender needed.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta, then drain.
Stir the cheddar, mustard and paprika into the squash sauce until melted and silky.
Toss in the pasta, loosening with a splash of milk or water.
Serve with an extra pinch of paprika.

title: Butternut squash & chickpea coconut curry
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the squash, chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes until the squash is tender.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Crush a few pieces of squash into the sauce to thicken it and brighten with the lime juice.
Serve over the rice.

title: West African-style peanut chicken stew
steps: Season the chicken and brown in the oil for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Whisk the peanut butter into 400 ml boiling water with the bouillon, then add it with the tomatoes, sweet potato and chicken.
Simmer gently for 25 minutes until rich and the chicken is tender.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Serve over rice with chopped peanuts and lime.

title: Chicken, chorizo & potato traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the potatoes, onions, peppers and garlic with the oil, paprika, oregano and salt on a large tray — small potato chunks cook in time with the chicken.
Sit the chicken on top and scatter the chorizo around.
Roast for 35 minutes until the chicken is crisp and the chorizo oil has run into the potatoes.
Squeeze over the lemon.
Serve straight from the tray.

title: Baked lemon orzo with zucchini & feta
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Stir the orzo, zucchini, garlic, spinach, oregano, lemon zest and hot stock together in a baking dish.
Scatter the tomatoes over, sit the block of feta in the middle and drizzle everything with the oil.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 10 minutes until the orzo is tender and the feta is golden at the edges.
Break up the feta, squeeze over the lemon and finish with basil and chili.

title: Slow-cooker chicken & sausage cassoulet
steps: Brown the sausages and chicken in the oil for 6 minutes — colour here means flavour later — and put them in the slow cooker.
Soften the onion and carrot in the same pan for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add to the slow cooker with the tomatoes, beans, bouillon, thyme, salt and 300 ml water.
Cook on low for 6 hours until the chicken is falling apart, then slice the sausages back in.
Toast the breadcrumbs in a dry pan with a drizzle of oil until golden and scatter over.
Serve with crusty bread.

title: Slow-cooker beef ragù with penne
steps: Season the beef and brown hard in the oil for 5 minutes, then put in the slow cooker.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the same pan for 6 minutes, then the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add to the slow cooker with the tomatoes, herbs and salt.
Cook on low for 7 hours until the beef falls apart.
Shred the beef into the sauce and stir in the balsamic.
Toss with the cooked pasta and a splash of pasta water and serve with parmesan.

title: Slow-cooker Thai peanut chicken
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, curry paste, honey and garlic in the slow cooker.
Add the chicken and peppers and turn to coat.
Cook on low for 4 hours until tender.
Shred the chicken into the sauce and squeeze in the juice of 1 lime.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Serve over rice with lime wedges.

title: Folded tortilla wrap hack
steps: Cut a slit from the centre of each tortilla to the edge.
Picture four quarters: cover one with ham, one with cheddar, one with avocado and one with tomato, spinach and sriracha mayo.
Fold the first quarter up over the next, and keep folding round into a layered triangle.
Toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes on each side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts.

title: Crispy chickpea Caesar salad
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss the chickpeas and bread with the oil and paprika and roast for 20 minutes until crunchy.
Whisk the yogurt, half the parmesan, the lemon juice, mustard and garlic into a punchy dressing.
Toss the lettuce in the dressing until every leaf is coated.
Pile on the crispy chickpeas and croutons and finish with the rest of the parmesan.

title: Khao soi-style curry noodle soup
steps: Fry the curry paste, curry powder and turmeric in the oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, stock and chicken and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is tender. Season with fish sauce and sugar.
Cook the noodles, and fry a small handful of them in a little oil until crisp for the topping.
Ladle the curry over the soft noodles and top with crispy noodles, red onion, cilantro, chili and lime.

title: Tuna & egg kimbap rolls
steps: Heat the rice and season with half the sesame oil and a pinch of salt.
Cook the egg as a thin omelette and cut into strips. Quickly fry the carrot, then wilt the spinach with a pinch of salt.
Lay a nori sheet on a board, spread a thin layer of rice over two-thirds, and line up tuna mayo, egg, carrot, spinach and cucumber near the bottom edge.
Roll up tightly, brush with the rest of the sesame oil, sprinkle with sesame and slice with a wet knife. Repeat.

title: Butternut squash & red pepper soup
steps: Cook the onion, peppers and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes, then stir in the paprika.
Add the squash, 900 ml boiling water and the bouillon and simmer for 18 minutes until soft.
Blend until velvety and season.
Serve with a swirl of sour cream and toast.

title: Crispy chicken & cheese quesadillas
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices and cook in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Scatter cheese over half of each tortilla, add the chicken and spring onion and top with more cheese — cheese on both sides glues it together.
Fold and cook in a dry pan over a medium heat for 3 minutes on each side until deep golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa, sour cream and lime.

title: Freezer bean & cheese burritos
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the spices and beans and mash roughly with a splash of water.
Heat the rice and mix with the lime juice.
Fill each tortilla with beans, rice, salsa and cheese, fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Toast seam-side down in a dry pan until golden, or wrap in foil and freeze. Microwave from frozen for 3 minutes.

title: Thai beef & noodle salad
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6 minutes, then rinse cold.
Sear the steak in the oil in a smoking-hot pan for 3 minutes on each side, rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly — one steak flavours the whole salad.
Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chili; it should taste hot, sour, salty and sweet at once.
Toss the noodles, lettuce, cucumber, onion and cilantro with most of the dressing, top with the beef and peanuts and spoon over the rest.

title: Antipasto chickpea salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano.
Toss the chickpeas, peppers, olives, tomato and onion in the dressing and leave for 10 minutes.
Fold in the ham and mozzarella.
It keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

title: Miso glazed eggplant rice bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Brush the cut side of the eggplant with oil and roast cut-side down for 20 minutes until meltingly soft.
Mix the miso, honey and vinegar, flip the eggplant, spread with the glaze and roast for 5 minutes until bubbling and caramelised.
Heat the rice with the edamame.
Serve the eggplant over the rice with cucumber, spring onion and sesame.

title: Zucchini & corn fritters with tomato salsa
steps: Mix the zucchini, corn, eggs, flour, feta and spring onion — squeezing the zucchini dry keeps them crisp.
Fry heaped spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes on each side until golden.
Mix the tomato with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Serve the hot fritters with the salsa on top.

title: Chicken gyro chopped salad with pitta croutons
steps: Toss the chicken with the oregano, paprika, half the lemon juice and 1 tbsp oil, then fry for 7 minutes until charred.
Fry the pitta squares in the rest of the oil until crunchy.
Mix the yogurt with the garlic and the rest of the lemon juice.
Toss everything together with the garlic yogurt and top with feta.

title: Crispy pesto eggs on toast
steps: Spoon the pesto into a cold non-stick pan and heat until it sizzles.
Crack the eggs straight into the pesto and fry for 3 minutes until the edges are lacy and crisp.
Toast the bread.
Slide the eggs on top and finish with chili.

title: Cheesy egg-in-a-hole toast
steps: Cut a hole in the middle of each slice of bread with a glass.
Melt the butter in a frying pan, add the bread and crack an egg into each hole.
Scatter cheese around the edge, cook for 2 minutes, then flip carefully and cook for 1 minute so the cheese crisps underneath.
Fry the cut-out circles alongside for dipping and serve with blistered tomatoes and spring onion.

title: Mini pancake cereal
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, egg, milk and 1 tbsp maple syrup into a smooth batter and pour into a zip bag with a corner snipped off.
Wipe a non-stick pan with oil and squeeze in lots of coin-sized dots.
Cook for 1 minute until bubbles appear, flip and cook for 30 seconds.
Pile into bowls with berries, yogurt and the rest of the maple syrup, and eat with a spoon like cereal.

title: Sheet-pan berry pancakes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a baking tray.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs, milk, butter and 1 tbsp maple syrup into a smooth batter.
Pour onto the tray and scatter with the berries.
Bake for 15 minutes until golden and springy, then cut into squares and drizzle with the rest of the maple syrup.

title: Peanut butter breakfast cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a tray.
Mix everything together into a thick, sticky dough.
Scoop 8 mounds onto the tray and flatten slightly — they don't spread.
Bake for 12–14 minutes until golden at the edges. Keep for 4 days.

title: Make-ahead ham & cheese breakfast strata
steps: Layer the bread, ham and most of the cheese in a buttered baking dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt, pour over and press the bread down. Chill overnight.
Top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 40–45 minutes until puffed and set.
Rest for 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Honey roasted grapes on yogurt toast
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and roast the grapes with the honey and oil for 15 minutes until they burst and turn jammy.
Toast the sourdough.
Spread thickly with the yogurt.
Spoon over the hot grapes and their juices and add a crack of pepper.

title: Avocado & fried egg tostadas
steps: Brush the tortillas with a little oil and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 6–8 minutes until crisp.
Warm and mash the beans, and mash the avocado with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil until crisp at the edges.
Layer the tostadas with beans, avocado and eggs and finish with chili flakes.

title: Eggs in purgatory
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic and chili until the garlic just turns gold.
Add the tomatoes and herbs and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites set and the yolks are runny.
Finish with parmesan and serve with toast for dipping.

title: Sweet potato cinnamon pancakes
steps: Prick the sweet potato and microwave for 6 minutes until soft, then scoop out and mash.
Whisk the mash with the eggs, flour, baking powder, cinnamon and milk.
Cook spoonfuls in a buttered non-stick pan for 2 minutes on each side over a medium-low heat — they colour fast.
Stack with yogurt and a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Air-fryer pasta chips with marinara
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until just tender, drain and pat dry.
Toss with the oil, parmesan, garlic powder and herbs.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10–12 minutes, shaking twice, until golden and crunchy. Warm the passata with the chili to dip.

title: Crispy kimchi pancake bites
steps: Mix the flour, cornstarch, kimchi and its juice, spring onions and 4 tbsp cold water into a thick batter.
Fry small spoonfuls in the oil for 2–3 minutes on each side until lacy and crisp.
Serve with soy sauce for dipping.

title: Cheesy garlic bread bites
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Mix the flour, yogurt and baking powder into a dough and roll into 16 balls.
Mix the butter, garlic and parsley, roll the balls in it and pack into a small baking dish.
Scatter with mozzarella and bake for 15 minutes until golden and stretchy.

title: Tortilla mini quiche cups
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Cut 12 circles from the tortillas and press into a muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt and stir in the spinach and cheese.
Fill the cups, top each with a tomato half and bake for 15 minutes until set and the edges are crisp.

title: Two-ingredient dough pizza pinwheels
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Mix the flour, yogurt and baking powder into a dough and roll into a rectangle.
Spread with passata, sprinkle with oregano, ham and mozzarella, roll up tightly and cut into 12 slices.
Bake cut-side up on a lined tray for 16–18 minutes until golden.

title: Chocolate hummus with apple slices
steps: Blend the chickpeas, melted chocolate, maple syrup, peanut butter and milk until completely smooth like brownie batter.
Chill for 10 minutes.
Serve with apple slices for dipping.

title: Air-fryer potato wedges with garlic yogurt
steps: Toss the wedges with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 18–20 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp outside and fluffy inside.
Mix the yogurt with the garlic and chili and serve for dipping.

title: Frozen mango lassi pops
steps: Blend the mango, yogurt, honey, lime juice and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into lolly moulds or small cups with sticks.
Freeze for at least 4 hours.

title: BBQ tofu with potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Cut the potatoes into thick wedges, leaving the skins on.
Toss the wedges with half the oil, the paprika and half the salt. Spread them cut-side down on a tray.
Roast for 35–40 minutes, turning halfway, until browned and tender inside.
Pat the tofu dry and cut it into thick slabs. Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan and brown the slabs for 4 minutes on each side.
Lower the heat, brush both sides of the tofu with barbecue sauce and turn for another minute until the glaze clings.
Shred the cabbage finely and toss it with the vinegar and remaining salt. Serve beside the wedges and tofu.

title: Sweet potato and lentil dhal
steps: Dice the onion and grate the garlic and ginger. Rinse the lentils until the water is mostly clear.
Warm the oil in a deep pan. Soften the onion for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, ginger, cumin and turmeric for 30 seconds.
Stir in the sweet potato, drained lentils, coconut milk and stock. Bring to a gentle bubble.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring the bottom regularly, until the lentils collapse and a knife slips through the sweet potato.
Mash a few pieces of sweet potato against the side of the pan to thicken the dhal. Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Squeeze in lemon to taste and spoon into bowls with a little coconut yoghurt on top.

title: Chickpea and potato curry with rice
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 2 cm pieces. Finely dice the onion and grate the garlic and ginger.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the onion for 6 minutes until golden at the edges.
Add the garlic, ginger, garam masala and ground coriander. Stir for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and stock.
Tip in the potatoes, cover and simmer for 16–20 minutes. Cook the basmati in a separate pan following the packet.
Stir the drained chickpeas into the curry and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the sauce coats them.
Fluff the rice and share it between bowls. Ladle the curry alongside and scatter over chopped coriander.

title: Lentil and vegetable curry
steps: Cut the cauliflower into small florets and slice the carrots thinly. Trim the beans and halve them crosswise.
Finely chop the onion and soften it in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes. Stir in the curry powder until fragrant.
Add rinsed lentils, carrots, coconut milk and stock. Simmer for 10 minutes while the rice cooks in a separate pan.
Put in the cauliflower and cook for another 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the beans for the final 4 minutes so they keep some bite. Loosen the curry with a splash of water if it thickens too far.
Squeeze in the lime and serve the curry beside the fluffed rice with chopped coriander.

title: Lentil and vegetable rice skillet
steps: Rinse the long-grain rice and lentils together in a fine sieve, then let them drain well.
Dice the onion and cook it in a lidded frying pan with the oil for 5 minutes. Stir in the crushed garlic and paprika.
Add the drained grains and stir for a minute so they take up the paprika oil.
Pour in the stock and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook on low for 14 minutes.
Scatter the frozen vegetables over the top. Cover for 5 minutes, then check that the rice is tender before resting off the heat for 3 minutes.
Fold the vegetables through the rice and finish with chopped parsley and lemon juice.

title: Red lentil and vegetable stew
steps: Slice the carrots into thick coins. Chop the celery and onion, and crush the garlic.
Heat half the oil in a deep pan and cook the onion and celery for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.
Add the carrots, drained rinsed lentils, tomatoes and stock. Bring to a simmer.
Cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring from the bottom every few minutes, until the carrots are soft and the lentils have thickened the broth.
Strip the kale from its stems, tear the leaves and stir them in for the final 4 minutes.
Finish with the vinegar. Divide into bowls and drizzle with the remaining olive oil.

title: Kidney bean and cabbage stew
steps: Chop the onion and crush the garlic. Slice the cabbage into broad ribbons and cube the potatoes.
Warm the oil in a casserole and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the cabbage and drained, rinsed kidney beans. Cover and simmer for 12–15 minutes until the potatoes and cabbage are tender.
Crush a few of the potatoes against the side of the pan. Stir them back through to give the broth a little body.
Stir in the vinegar and ladle into bowls with roughly chopped parsley.

title: Fruit and nut snack clusters
steps: Roughly chop the nuts and raisins and line a tray that fits in the fridge with baking paper.
Break the chocolate into a heatproof bowl. Microwave in short bursts, stirring between each, until almost melted.
Stir until smooth, then fold in the nuts, raisins and a pinch of salt.
Drop 12 small mounds onto the tray. Chill for 20 minutes or until firm, then peel them off the paper. Three make one portion.

title: Chickpea and avocado stuffed peppers

ingredients.note: choose small red and yellow peppers

steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Mash them with a fork until some split and others are still whole.
Scoop the avocado into the bowl, squeeze in half the lime and mash again. Fold in chopped coriander and a pinch of salt.
Quarter the peppers lengthways and remove the seeds and white ribs to make little boats.
Spoon the chickpea mixture into the pepper pieces just before serving. Squeeze the remaining lime over the top.

title: Spicy black bean and corn dip
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut the tortillas into wedges and brush them lightly with half the oil.
Bake the wedges for 8–10 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp. Cool on the tray.
Pat the sweetcorn dry and cook it in a hot frying pan with the remaining oil for 4 minutes until it starts to char.
Mash the rinsed beans with lime juice, cumin, salt and enough water to make a thick dip.
Spoon over the charred corn and thinly sliced chilli, and scatter on chopped coriander. Serve with the tortilla wedges.

title: Spicy tofu and lentil curry
steps: Pat the tofu dry and cut it into bite-size cubes. Dice the onion, grate the garlic and ginger, and slice the chilli.
Heat half the oil in a frying pan. Brown the tofu on two sides for 6–8 minutes, then lift it onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and half the chilli for 30 seconds.
Add rinsed lentils, coconut milk and stock. Simmer for about 18 minutes, stirring regularly, until the lentils are soft.
Fold the tofu into the curry and simmer for another 3 minutes. Add lime juice to brighten the sauce.
Divide into bowls and finish with chopped coriander and the remaining chilli.

title: Thai basil beef bowls
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it following the packet. Slice the pepper, chop the garlic and chilli, and pick the basil leaves.
Mix the soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar with 2 tablespoons of water and set it beside the hob.
Heat the oil in a wide frying pan until shimmering. Press the beef into the pan and leave it alone for 3 minutes so it browns.
Break up the beef and cook through. Push it aside, stir-fry the pepper for 2 minutes and add the garlic and chilli.
Pour in the sauce and toss over high heat until it glazes the beef. Take off the heat and fold in the basil until just wilted.
Spoon the beef and peppers over the rice and squeeze a little lime over each portion.

title: Honey sriracha chicken and rice bowls
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it following the packet. Thinly slice the cucumber and spring onions.
Stir the sriracha, honey, soy and vinegar together with 2 tablespoons of water. Crush the garlic separately.
Heat the oil in a wide pan. Spread the chicken loosely in the pan and let it brown for 2 minutes before breaking it up.
Stir-fry for 5–7 minutes, until the chicken reaches 74°C (165°F). Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and cook for a minute or two, until it forms a thin glaze on the chicken.
Pack the rice and chicken into shallow containers. Keep the cucumber and spring onions separate if chilling, and add them after reheating.

title: Honey gochujang chicken rice bowls
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Rinse the rice and set it cooking in a pan following the packet.
Mix the gochujang, honey, soy, half the vinegar and the oil. Set a spoonful of the glaze aside before adding the chicken.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces, coat with the remaining glaze and spread on a lined baking tray.
Roast for 18–22 minutes, until browned and cooked to 74°C (165°F). Brush with the reserved glaze for the final 3 minutes.
Shred the cabbage finely and squeeze it briefly with the remaining vinegar and salt.
Divide the rice, roast chicken and cabbage into bowls. Scatter the sesame seeds over the chicken.

title: Minced chicken fried rice
steps: Dice the carrot small and slice the spring onions, keeping the green tops separate. Beat the eggs with a fork.
Heat a little vegetable oil in a wide pan. Scramble the eggs in large curds, then lift them onto a clean plate.
Add the remaining oil and fry the minced chicken until browned and cooked to 74°C (165°F), breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the carrot and spring-onion whites. After 3 minutes, stir in the garlic and peas.
Crumble in the packet rice and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, until piping hot throughout. Add soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fold in the eggs, break up any large pieces and serve with spring-onion greens.

title: Teriyaki beef rice bowls
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it following the packet. Cut the broccoli into small florets.
Grate the ginger and garlic. Mix them with the soy, honey, vinegar and 80 ml water.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and brown the beef, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the broccoli and a spoonful of water, cover and cook for 3 minutes.
Whisk the cornflour into the sauce, pour it into the pan and toss until the beef is sizzling and glossy.
Spoon the beef and broccoli beside the rice and finish with sesame seeds and finely sliced spring onions.

title: Roast turkey breast with gravy
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Mash half the butter with garlic, thyme, pepper and half the salt. Spread it over the turkey.
Place the breast in a small roasting tin and roast for 45–60 minutes, until the centre registers 74°C (165°F).
Cut the carrots into batons, toss with oil and roast on a separate tray for the last 30 minutes.
Peel and cut the potatoes into large chunks. Boil for 15–18 minutes, drain and mash with the milk and remaining butter and salt.
Move the cooked turkey to a warm plate to rest. Whisk the flour into the cooking juices in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Gradually whisk in the stock and simmer until the gravy coats a spoon.
Carve the turkey across the grain. Serve with mash, carrots and a little gravy over each portion.

title: Garlic butter roast chicken

ingredients.note: choose a bird weighing around 1.4 kg bone-in

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and pat the chicken skin dry with kitchen paper.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic, lemon zest, thyme, salt and pepper. Rub it over the chicken and put the lemon halves inside.
Set the chicken in a roasting tin. Halve any large potatoes, toss them with the oil and spread them around the bird.
Roast for 70–85 minutes, turning the potatoes halfway through. The thickest parts of the breast and thigh should reach 74°C (165°F), away from bone.
Rest the chicken for 15 minutes. Boil the green beans for 4 minutes, drain and toss with a little of the cooking juices.
Put the rested chicken on a platter with the roast potatoes and green beans, then carve at the table.

title: Thai red pumpkin curry

ingredients.note: seeded, choose kabocha if leaving the skin on

steps: Cut the pumpkin into 3 cm chunks. Thinly slice the onion trim the green beans and slice the chilli.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Add the curry paste and cook for a minute.
Stir in a little coconut milk to loosen the paste. Add the pumpkin, remaining coconut milk and stock.
Simmer for about 14 minutes while you cook the rice in a separate pan following the packet.
Add the beans and chilli and simmer until the vegetables are tender. Squeeze in lime juice and stir in torn basil.
Spoon the curry into wide bowls and serve next to the rice.

title: Ham and broccoli egg bake
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and butter a small square baking dish.
Cut the broccoli into florets, blanch for 2 minutes in boiling water and drain thoroughly. Dice the ham.
Beat the eggs, milk and pepper with a fork. Grate the cheddar.
Spread the ham and broccoli in the dish and pour over the eggs. Sprinkle the top with cheddar.
Bake for 22–26 minutes until the middle is set and the cheese is golden. Rest for 5 minutes before cutting into four squares.

title: Bacon and asparagus frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Snap the woody ends from the asparagus and cut the spears into short pieces.
Slice the bacon and fry it in a small ovenproof pan until lightly crisp. Add a little oil if the pan is dry.
Add the asparagus and cook for 3 minutes. Beat the eggs with pepper and the grated cheddar.
Pour the eggs over the bacon and asparagus. Let the edges set without stirring, then transfer the pan to the oven.
Bake for 6–8 minutes until the centre is just set. Let it settle for 2 minutes before cutting into wedges.

title: Crustless spinach and tomato quiche
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Brush a shallow round dish with a little of the oil.
Warm the remaining oil in a pan. Stir in crushed garlic for 20 seconds, then wilt the spinach and squeeze out the excess liquid.
Beat the eggs with cottage cheese and pepper. Fold in the spinach and half the cheddar.
Pour into the dish and top with halved tomatoes, cut-side up, and the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until the middle is set. Rest for 5 minutes so you can lift out clean wedges.

title: Korean steamed eggs with prawns
steps: Thinly slice the spring onions, keeping the green tops separate. Pat the prawns dry.
Whisk the eggs with the stock, soy sauce and spring-onion whites until evenly mixed.
Pour into a heatproof bowl. Set the bowl above gently simmering water in a covered pan, keeping the water below the bowl.
Steam for 8 minutes until the edges begin to set. Nestle the prawns on top and cover again.
Steam for another 4–6 minutes until the prawns are pink and opaque and the eggs are set. Finish with spring-onion greens and sesame oil.

title: Denver scrambled eggs on toast
steps: Finely dice the ham, green pepper and onion. Beat the eggs with pepper and grate the cheddar.
Toast the sourdough in a dry pan. Spread it with a little of the butter and keep it warm.
Melt the rest of the butter in a frying pan. Soften the onion and green pepper for 4 minutes, then add the ham for a minute.
Turn the heat to low, pour in the eggs and draw a spatula slowly across the pan to make soft curds.
Add the cheddar just before the eggs finish setting. Serve the scramble beside the toast.

title: Loaded breakfast burritos
steps: Dice the potato into small cubes. Boil for 6 minutes, then drain well.
Heat half the oil in a frying pan and cook the potato until crisp and tender. Move it to a clean plate.
Fry the sausage in the same pan until fully cooked, breaking it into small pieces. Move it to the plate with the potato.
Beat the eggs with pepper and make soft scrambled eggs over low heat in the remaining oil.
Warm the tortillas and fill each with potato, sausage, eggs, grated cheddar and finely diced tomato.
Tuck the sides in, roll tightly and toast seam-side down in the dry pan. Cut in half before serving.

title: Chicken Philly cheesesteak
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (410°F). Cut the baguette into four pieces and split each piece lengthways.
Thinly slice the chicken, peppers and onion. Toss the chicken with garlic powder, pepper and salt.
In a wide frying pan, soften the peppers and onion in half the oil for 6 minutes, then move them onto a plate.
Use the remaining oil to fry the chicken until it reaches 74°C (165°F). Stir the peppers and onion back in.
Pile the filling into the rolls and lay thin slices of mozzarella on top. Heat in the oven until the cheese has melted and the bread is crisp.

title: Chicken and butternut squash stew
steps: Cut the chicken and squash into bite-size chunks. Dice the onion and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil in a heavy pan and brown the chicken. Lift it out onto a clean plate.
Soften the onion in the same pan for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, thyme and flour and stir for a minute.
Gradually stir in the stock. Return the chicken with the squash and cook at a gentle simmer for about 20 minutes.
Add the drained beans and simmer until the squash is tender and the chicken reaches 74°C (165°F).
Squeeze in lemon juice and add black pepper to taste. Spoon into bowls with plenty of the broth.

title: Mac and cheese with ham
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Dice the ham and grate the cheddar.
Cook the macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet suggests. Drain well.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour and cook for a minute until it smells lightly toasted.
Add the milk gradually, whisking between additions. Simmer until thick, then take off the heat and stir in the mustard, seasoning and most of the cheese.
Fold the macaroni and diced ham through the sauce. Transfer to a baking dish and scatter the remaining cheese over it.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until bubbling with golden patches. Rest for 3 minutes before serving.

title: Crab mac and cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (410°F). Cook the macaroni for a minute less than the packet suggests.
Pick through the crab for pieces of shell and tear any large lumps into bite-size pieces.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook for a minute. Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer until it coats a spoon.
Take off the heat and stir in grated cheddar, pepper and a little lemon zest. Fold in the drained macaroni and crab, leaving some crab pieces intact.
Spoon into a baking dish and sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Bake for 10–12 minutes, until the edges bubble and the crumbs are lightly browned.
Scatter over chopped parsley and finish with a squeeze of lemon just before serving.

title: Buffalo chicken mac and cheese
steps: Put the macaroni on to boil. In a second pan, cover the chicken with water and bring it to a gentle simmer.
Poach the chicken for 12–16 minutes until the thickest part reaches 74°C (165°F). Drain it and pull it into small shreds with forks.
Melt the butter in a saucepan and stir in the flour and garlic powder for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk. Simmer until smooth and thick, then take off the heat and stir in the grated cheddar and hot sauce.
Drain the macaroni and fold it into the sauce with the shredded chicken. Loosen with a splash of the pasta water if needed.
Divide into bowls and scatter with thinly sliced spring onions.

title: Classic glazed beef meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Grate the onion and soak the breadcrumbs in half the milk.
Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce and half the salt with a fork or your hands. Stop once combined.
Shape into a low loaf on a lined baking tray. Mix the ketchup and mustard and spread half over the loaf.
Bake for 40–50 minutes until the centre reaches 71°C (160°F). Brush with the remaining glaze for the final 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the peeled and chopped potatoes until soft. Drain and mash with butter, the rest of the milk and salt. Boil the peas for 3 minutes.
Rest the meatloaf for 10 minutes, then cut it into thick slices and serve beside the mash and peas.

title: Steamed pork dumpling lasagne
steps: Very finely shred the cabbage, toss with salt and leave for 5 minutes. Squeeze it dry.
Mix the cabbage with minced pork, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and the sliced spring-onion whites.
Set four small heatproof dishes out. Cover the bases with wrappers, spread a thin layer of filling on top, then repeat and finish with wrappers.
Put the dishes in a covered steamer set over gently boiling water. Steam for 18–23 minutes until the centres reach 71°C (160°F).
Heat the vegetable oil in a small pan and pour it over the chilli flakes in a heatproof bowl. Let them sizzle and settle.
Run a knife around the edge of each dumpling stack and slide it onto a plate with a spatula. Scatter over the spring-onion greens and spoon on a little chilli oil.

title: Spaghetti Alfredo
steps: Bring a pan of water to the boil, add salt and cook the spaghetti until just firm in the centre.
Grate the parmesan finely while the spaghetti cooks. Scoop out a mug of the pasta water before draining.
Warm the butter and cream in a wide pan over low heat until the butter melts. Avoid a hard boil.
Add the spaghetti and a splash of pasta water. Turn it through the warm cream with tongs.
Take the pan off the heat. Toss in most of the parmesan a little at a time until the sauce clings to the strands.
Add a final splash of pasta water if the sauce feels tight. Twist the spaghetti into bowls and finish with the remaining parmesan and cracked black pepper.

title: French onion chicken orzo
steps: Thinly slice the onions. Heat the oven to 210°C (410°F) and season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a wide ovenproof pan. Brown the thighs on both sides, then lift them onto a plate.
Melt the butter in the same pan and cook the onions on medium-low for about 20 minutes. Scrape the pan and add a splash of water when the onions catch.
Add the thyme, Worcestershire sauce, orzo and stock. Stir well and nestle the chicken and its juices into the orzo.
Bake for 14 minutes, then scatter torn mozzarella over the pan and bake until the orzo is tender and the chicken reaches 74°C (165°F).
Rest for 3 minutes, then serve each piece of chicken over orzo with the caramelised onions scooped on top.

title: Creamy Italian sausage pasta
steps: Chop the onion and crush the garlic. Set the rigatoni cooking in a separate pan.
Heat the oil and pinch the sausage meat into small lumps. Leave them to brown before stirring.
Add the onion and cook until soft, then add the garlic and herbs for another minute.
Stir in the passata and simmer for 8–10 minutes until the sausage is cooked and the tomato tastes mellow.
Stir in the cream. Drain the rigatoni, keeping a cup of the cooking water, and fold the pasta through the sauce.
Loosen with pasta water as needed and serve with torn basil.

title: Caramelised cabbage pasta
steps: Halve the cabbage and cut it into thin ribbons. Thinly slice the onion and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil and half of the butter in a wide pan. Fry the onion for 5 minutes over medium heat.
Add the cabbage and salt in two batches. Let it brown against the pan before tossing, then continue for about 12 minutes until tender.
Cook the spaghetti until just firm and reserve a mug of the cooking water. Stir the garlic into the cabbage.
Add the drained spaghetti, remaining butter and a splash of pasta water. Toss until the cabbage is distributed between the strands.
Squeeze over lemon, divide into bowls and finish with parsley and cracked pepper.

title: Chicken tetrazzini
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Simmer the chicken in water until the thickest part reaches 74°C (165°F), then shred it.
Cook the spaghetti for 2 minutes less than the packet suggests. Drain and set it aside.
Slice the mushrooms and onion. Fry them in half the butter until the water from the mushrooms evaporates.
Stir in the remaining butter, flour and thyme. Slowly whisk in the milk and stock. Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Add the pepper, spaghetti, chicken and half the parmesan. Tip into a baking dish and top with breadcrumbs and the remaining parmesan.
Bake for 15–18 minutes until bubbling at the sides and golden. Let it settle briefly before serving.

title: Meatball-stuffed pasta shells
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (410°F). Lightly oil a baking tray and set a pan of water on to boil.
Mix the beef with breadcrumbs, egg, half the crushed garlic, half the herbs, salt and pepper. Roll into small meatballs.
Bake the meatballs for 12–15 minutes until brown and cooked to 71°C (160°F). Meanwhile, boil the shells for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Stir the remaining garlic and herbs into the passata. Spread half of the sauce in a baking dish.
Set the shells in the dish, open side up, and tuck a small meatball into each. Spoon over the remaining sauce and scatter with torn mozzarella.
Bake for about 15 minutes until the sauce bubbles and the mozzarella turns golden in patches.

title: Sausage and kale zuppa toscana
steps: Slice the potatoes into thin half-moons. Chop the onion and garlic and tear the kale from its stems.
Heat the oil in a deep pan. Crumble the sausage meat into it and cook until browned, breaking up large pieces.
Stir in the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the stock and add the sliced potatoes. Simmer for 12–15 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the sausage is cooked.
Stir in the torn kale and simmer for 3 minutes, then add the cream and warm it gently.
Taste, finish with pepper and ladle into bowls with an even share of sausage, potatoes and greens.

title: Unstuffed pepper skillet
steps: Dice the red and green peppers and onion. Rinse and drain the rice.
Heat the oil in a deep lidded frying pan. Brown the beef, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the peppers and onions and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, oregano and pepper.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes and stock. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook over low heat for 17–20 minutes.
Check that the rice is tender and stir gently. Add a little water and cook a few minutes longer if needed.
Sprinkle with cheddar and cover off the heat for 2 minutes to melt the cheese.

title: Brothy ginger beef bowls
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it following the packet. Slice the ginger, garlic and spring onions.
Put the stock, ginger, garlic and spring-onion whites in a saucepan. Simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Pat the steak dry and sear it in the hot oil on both sides. For medium, take it off at 63°C (145°F) and rest it for at least 3 minutes.
Strain the broth if you prefer it clear. Stir in the soy and vinegar, and simmer the quartered pak choi for 3 minutes.
Slice the beef thinly across the grain while the greens cook.
Spoon rice into deep bowls, add the sliced steak and pak choi, then ladle over the broth and finish with spring-onion greens.

title: Cheesy chicken crescent rolls
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a baking tray.
Gently simmer the chicken in water until it reaches 74°C (165°F). Drain, shred and let it cool briefly.
Mix the shredded chicken with cream cheese, grated cheddar, pepper and most of the finely sliced spring onions.
Separate the chilled dough into eight triangles. Put filling on the wide end of each triangle and roll it up.
Set seam-side down on the tray and bake for 13–17 minutes, until puffed and deeply golden.
Rest for 3 minutes. Cut one roll open for serving and scatter on the remaining spring onions.

title: Garlic parmesan cheeseburger bombs
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (410°F) and line a baking tray. Dice the onion finely.
Dry-fry the beef and onion until the beef is cooked. Break up the mince, drain any excess fat and spread it on a plate to cool.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt and yoghurt into a soft dough. Knead briefly and divide into eight balls.
Flatten each ball and fill with beef and a cube of cheddar. Pinch tightly shut and put seam-side down on the tray.
Bake for 15–18 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Melt the butter with crushed garlic. Brush it over the bread, then scatter with finely grated parmesan and parsley.

title: Crispy rice paper beef burgers
steps: Shred the cabbage finely and slice the spring onions. Mix the beef with soy and pepper and shape into four thin patties.
Fry the patties in half the oil until browned and cooked to 71°C (160°F). Transfer to a clean plate.
Briefly dip rice-paper sheets in water, one at a time. Layer three sheets for each burger on a damp board.
Put a patty, cabbage and spring onion in the centre. Tuck in the sides and fold tightly to enclose it.
Fry the parcels in the remaining oil for 2–3 minutes on each side until crisp. Work in batches so they do not touch.
Set the parcels on a rack for a minute, then halve and serve with ketchup for dipping.

title: Hot honey crispy chicken burgers
steps: Slice the chicken into four even cutlets. Shred the cabbage finely and thinly slice the cucumber.
Toss the cabbage and cucumber with vinegar and salt and let them stand while you cook the chicken.
Coat the chicken with flour, beaten egg and then breadcrumbs, pressing the crumbs on.
Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and cook the cutlets in batches until crisp on both sides and 74°C (165°F) in the centre.
Warm the honey and hot sauce together in a small pan. Drain the cutlets on a rack, then brush them with the glaze.
Toast the buns, drain the cabbage and cucumber, and build each burger with the vegetables and a glazed chicken cutlet.

title: BBQ cheeseburger sliders
steps: Thinly slice the onions. Melt butter with the oil in a pan and cook the onions gently until brown and soft.
Shape the meat into four small flat patties and season the outside with salt.
Open the buns and toast their cut sides in a clean hot pan.
Cook the patties in the hot pan until browned, turning once. Cook to 71°C (160°F) in the centre.
Top with sliced cheddar and cover the pan for a minute to melt it.
Spread barbecue sauce on the buns, then add the cheeseburger patties and a spoon of the caramelised onions.

title: Chicken parmesan sliders
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Cut the chicken into even pieces that will fit the buns.
Dip the chicken in beaten egg, then press it into breadcrumbs mixed with the grated parmesan.
Brush a tray and the chicken lightly with oil. Bake for 12–16 minutes, turning once, until golden and 74°C (165°F) in the centre.
Meanwhile, gently simmer the passata with crushed garlic for 8 minutes until thick enough to spoon.
Split the buns and top with the chicken, tomato sauce and torn mozzarella. Return to the oven until the cheese melts.
Tuck in basil leaves and close the buns just before serving.

title: Ham and cheese sliders
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and line a small baking dish.
Split the buns and arrange their bottom halves in the dish. Fold the ham onto them and top with slices of cheddar.
Set the tops in place. Melt the butter and stir in the mustard and onion powder. Brush the mixture over the buns.
Cover loosely and bake for 10 minutes, then uncover for 5–6 minutes, until the tops are golden and the cheese has melted.

title: Chicken bacon ranch salad
steps: Cook the bacon in a frying pan until crisp, then move it to kitchen paper to drain.
Slice the chicken into thin cutlets. Fry in the olive oil until golden and 74°C (165°F) in the centre, then set aside to rest.
For the ranch dressing, whisk the yoghurt, mayonnaise, thyme, garlic powder, onion powder, chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Chop the lettuce and cut the tomatoes into small wedges. Slice the rested chicken and crumble the cooked bacon.
Divide the lettuce and tomato into bowls. Add the chicken and bacon and drizzle with the ranch just before serving.

title: Parmesan-crusted chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Cut the potato into small chunks and toss with half the oil and salt.
Roast the potatoes for 20 minutes. Cut the broccoli into florets, toss lightly with oil and add it to the tray for another 12–15 minutes.
Slice the chicken into four even cutlets. Set out flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs mixed with grated parmesan.
Coat each piece with flour, egg and the parmesan crumbs. Press the crumbs in gently so they stick.
Fry the cutlets in the remaining oil in batches until golden and 74°C (165°F) in the centre.
Serve the chicken beside the browned potatoes and broccoli, with lemon wedges for squeezing.

title: Yucatán steak tacos
steps: Mix orange juice, juice from one lime, crushed garlic, paprika, oregano, cumin and half the salt in a shallow dish.
Coat the steak with the citrus mixture. Finely slice the red onion and toss with juice from the second lime and the remaining salt.
Heat the oil in a heavy frying pan. Lift the steak out of the marinade, blot it lightly and sear on both sides.
For medium, cook to at least 63°C (145°F). Transfer to a board and rest for at least 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas one at a time in a dry pan. Keep them stacked under a clean cloth.
Slice the steak thinly across the grain and divide among the tortillas. Top with red onion and chopped coriander and serve with the last lime cut into wedges.

title: Salmon sushi tacos
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (410°F). Rinse the sushi rice and cook it following the packet.
Brush the tortillas lightly with oil and drape them over an ovenproof rack to make taco shells. Bake for 6–8 minutes until firm and lightly golden.
Brush the salmon with soy sauce and bake on a separate tray until it flakes easily and reaches 63°C (145°F).
Mix vinegar and sugar. Fold them through the hot rice and spread the rice out for a few minutes to cool.
Slice the avocado, cut the cucumber into thin sticks and flake the cooked salmon into chunks.
Cut the nori into half sheets and press one into each shell. Fill with the rice, salmon, avocado and cucumber, then sprinkle with sesame.

title: Cheesy chipotle beef tacos
steps: Dice the onion and finely chop the chipotles. Grate the cheese and slice the spring onions.
Fry the onion in half the oil for 4 minutes. Brown the mince in the same pan, breaking it into small pieces.
Stir in the chipotles, cumin and passata. Simmer until the mince is cooked and the sauce thick enough to sit on a spoon.
Warm the tortillas in a clean dry pan until flexible. Put a little grated cheese and some beef on one half of each.
Fold the tortillas over. Brush lightly with the remaining oil and fry on both sides until browned and crisp at the edges.
Scatter over the spring onions and serve with lime wedges.

title: Chicken and rice burritos
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it following the packet. Drain the beans, rinse them and warm them with a spoonful of water.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and toss with lime zest, paprika, cumin and salt.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the chicken until golden and 74°C (165°F) in the centre.
Squeeze the lime over the chicken and toss. Warm the tortillas briefly in a clean pan.
Lay out the rice in a strip down the middle of each tortilla. Top with the black beans, chicken and salsa.
Fold in both sides and roll up snugly. Toast in a dry pan until lightly marked on both sides, then slice across the middle.

title: Crispy beef burritos
steps: Dice the onion and roast peppers. Grate the cheddar and rinse the kidney beans.
Heat a little oil in a skillet and brown the beef, using a spoon to break it up.
Add the onion, paprika, cumin and tomato paste. Cook until the onion softens and the beef is fully cooked.
Fold in the beans and sliced peppers. Simmer briefly until the filling is thick and almost dry.
Put a quarter of the filling and cheese on each tortilla. Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Brush the skillet with the remaining oil and griddle the burritos seam-side down first. Turn until crisp, then halve to serve.

title: Oven-crisp chicken chimichangas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a baking tray.
Poach the chicken in gently simmering water until it reaches 74°C (165°F). Let it cool slightly before shredding.
Slice the peppers and onion. Fry them in half the oil for about 6 minutes until soft and browned at the edges.
Stir the shredded chicken, salsa, paprika and cumin into the peppers. Cook until the filling is thick rather than wet.
Fill the tortillas, tuck in the sides and roll tightly. Brush with the remaining oil and bake seam-side down for 12–15 minutes.
Cut each chimichanga in half on the diagonal and serve with sour cream alongside.

title: Honey lime chicken enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). In a saucepan, bring enough water to cover the chicken to a gentle simmer.
Poach the thighs until they reach 74°C (165°F). Drain and shred them, then toss with honey and juice from one lime.
Fry the crushed garlic in the oil for 30 seconds. Add the passata, paprika and cumin and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas to make them flexible. Spoon a little tomato sauce into a baking dish and roll a portion of chicken into each tortilla.
Set the rolls seam-side down. Spoon the remaining red sauce over them and scatter over the cheese. Bake for 15–18 minutes until bubbling.
Finish with chopped coriander and serve with wedges of the remaining lime.

title: White chicken and cheese enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Poach the chicken in gently simmering water until it reaches 74°C (165°F).
Shred the chicken and toss it with the cumin, pepper and half the chopped spring onions.
Melt the butter in a saucepan. Stir in the flour for a minute, then slowly whisk in the stock until the sauce thickens.
Take off the heat and stir in the sour cream. Spread a little of the white sauce in a baking dish.
